tei:div.tei:p: " &༄༅// 'brug lugs smon lam chen mo'i chog khrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa byang chub lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi blo sna chos la bsgyur te thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i lam yang dag pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang zhing khams mdzad pa 'phrin las gdul bya la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams ni/ sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs na bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams byang chub tu bsngos shing smon lam rgya chen po btab pa las byung ba yin la/ rang cag rnams kyang de yi rjes su slob phyir thos bsam sgom gsum la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci yang rung ba gsog par byed cing de rnams bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis yongs su zin te byang chub kyi rgyu ru 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa ni shin tu gal che/ thabs de gang zhe na/ rang cag dang po'i las can rnams la smon lam gyi cho ga 'di nyid bya sla la phan yon che bar mthong ste/ smon lam de'ang don la khyad par med kyang rnam pa phyag len la rgyal ba gong ma'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba re mchis kyang da lam 'dir ni kho bo rang nyid skya ser skye bo'i tshogs ji snyed cig dang lhan du smon lam gyi cho ga rgyas bsdus 'bring tsam zhig rgyun du lag len bstar bzhin pa'i tshul 'di nyin 'god pa la gsum ste/ dgos ched dang bcas cho ga'i rim pa ngos bzung ba/ sbyor ba bcas gshom/ cho ga'i rim pa dngos so// dang po dgos ched dang bcas cho ga'i rim pa ngos bzung ba ni/ snga dro nam langs nas nyin phyed bar mdo lugs kyi cho ga la brten nas thub dbang gnas brtan rnams mchod pa'i rim pa ste/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes pa'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i spyan sngar bskal bzang gi byang chub sems dpa' rnams rang rang gi sangs rgyas pa'i skabs kyi zhing yongs su gdams par mdzad pa na/

mthar bskal bzang gi rnam 'dren stong rtsa gzhan thams cad kyis spangs pa'i snyigs ma lnga bdo'i zhing rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams lhag pa'i thugs rje chen pos bdag gir mdzad de smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab ste seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags par mdzad pa na/ gzhan rnams me tog lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khyod ni pad dkar lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'o zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i tshul snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las gsungs pa bzhin rang cag rnams la sangs rgyas gzhan las lhag pa'i bka' drin bla na med pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po de nyid dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i bka' lung rjes su sgrub ste lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes te sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar da lta'ang 'jig rten na mngon sum du bzhugs pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams spyan 'dren pa/ phyag 'tshal ba/ khrus dang na bza' phul ba/ mchod bstod phul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ mtshan sngags bzlas pa/ zhal zas bsod pa nyin dgung gdug tshod kyi tshul du phul ba/ rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma bsngos te bstan pa srung ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'phrin las bcol ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams byang chub tu bsngo zhing smon lam 'debs pa'i ched du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam 'bum phrag bcu gnyis kyi don bsdus mdo phal po che'i bsngo ba'i le'u las byung ba/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa smon lam rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di nyid grangs gsog pa yin no// phyed yol nas phyi dro nyi nub bar sngags kyi cho ga ste snyigs dus kyi skyabs dang mgon mchog tu gyur pa rang cag rnams la sangs rgyas gzhan las lhag pa'i bka' drin can o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid bdud dang dam sri 'gong po rnams 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bzhengs pa/

kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i dag snang las byung ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin chen po dam tshig par gsal ba/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren te bstim pa/ gsol 'debs dbang bskur mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs dang*/ chos skyong mgon po lcam dral bka' sdod tshogs dang bcas pa la gtor ma bsngos te 'phrin las bcol ba/ rtsa gsum dam can chos skyong rnams la tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba sogs kyi dge rtsa bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis yongs su zin pa'i ched du bzang spyod smon lam gsog pa dang smon lam gyi rim pa gzhan yang ji tsam nus pa 'don rung ba yin no// gnyis pa sbyor ba bcas gshom ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam yang na phyi rol gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su mchod khang bkod pa khyad par 'phags pas brgyan cing mdzes pa'i nang du sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs pa'i mdun nam nye logs ci bde bar stegs bu gru bzhi'i khar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i dbus su mañdzi'am stegs khri khebs ldan khar ston pa'i sku brnyan byin ldan mthong na mi mthun pa med pa bzhugs su gsol/ mtha' skor du 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bkram/ gzhung du gtor 'bul tsheg zin med kyang bla ma dkon mchog spyi la lha bshos kyi tshul du 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma gcig/ de las cung dma' bar rgyal chen bzhi la bzhi dang gzhi bdag gi dkar gtor gcig /nye logs su cha gsum gyi gtor ma'ang bshams/ dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma'i mdun phyogs su spro na mchod pa brgya tshar ram yang na lha grangs dang mnyam pa bshams srol yod kyang bsdu na mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyad lnga bshams pas chog go// 'dir zhar 'phros su mchod mgo g.yas g.yon du bstan thangs kyi skor la mkhas pa'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba re yod pa de la rgyu mtshan rnam dag re yod par go ba len thub na 'gal ba med kyang*/ la las de ha ma go bar gcig shes bden na gcig rdzun dgos pa'i u tshugs la gzhi bcol bas/

la la rang gi bzhed srol dri ma med pa la the tshom gyis drwa bas bcings te yid mi ches pa dang*/ la la rang lugs phyogs 'dzin gyis gzhan lugs mtha' dag log par mthong ba dang*/ la la mgo rmongs te gang la cha 'jog dgos pa ma shes par 'di yin gtad gso med par 'gyur nyen che bas rang blos gang shes ltar cung zad zhu na/ de yang mkhas pa la las bdag bskyed mchod pa ni rang gi g.yas nas mgo brtsams te g.yon phyogs su bshams/ mdun bskyed mchod pa ni rten gyi g.yas nas mgo brtsams te g.yon phyogs su bshams par gsungs pa dang*/ la las pha rgyud kyi rigs la g.yas nas mgo brtsams/ ma rgyud kyi rigs la g.yon nas mgo brtsams par gsungs pa'ang don la 'thad par mthong zhing min zhes zhu rgyu mi 'dug /yang la las gsar ma'i lugs la rang gi g.yas nas mgo brtsams/ ma rgyud kyi rigs la g.yon nas 'go brtsams par gsungs pa'ang don la 'thad par mthong zhing min zhes zhu rgyu mi 'dug /rnying ma'i lugs la mdun rten gyi g.yas nas mgo brtsams pa yin zhes dang*/ la las mdun gyi g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su bshams pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs te dkyil 'khor bskor ba bzhin dang*/g.yas nas g.yon du bshams pa ni bon lugs dang 'dres pa ste/ chos skor dang bon skor zhes yongs su grags pa bzhin no zhes zer ro// de yang mtha' gcig tu mi bden te/ gsar ma ba lho 'brug gi phyag bzhes la bdag mdun sogs kyi dbye ba mi phyed par mchod mgo rang gi g.yas mdun gyi g.yon nas brtsams pa bden yang gzhan gsar ma yod tshad kyis de ltar mi bzhed pa ni mthong chos su grub/ rnying ma bas mdun rten gyi g.yas nas mgo brtsams pa phal cher bden yang mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ dper na rnying ma'i phyag srol yongs grags dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du mtshams 'dzin me tog /shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog /lho nub tu bdug spos/

nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas bcas 'god pa'i tshe mdun gyi g.yon phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du bkod pa mthong chos su grub/ der ma zad snga 'gyur rnying ma'i mkhas grub dpe bral dag gi gsung las/ mdun rten gyi g.yon shes rab stong pa nyid las mchod rdzas thabs kyi rnam pa shar ba'i tshul du g.yon nas 'go brtsams te g.yas phyogs su bshams dgos zhes thabs shes zung 'jug gi don la sbyar te gsungs pa shin tu legs shing lho 'brug gi phyag len yang de dang mthun par mthong bas mthar thug 'gal ba spu tsam mi 'dug /mdun gyi g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su bshams pa dang dkyil 'khor g.yas su bskor ba gnyis cung zad mi mtshungs te/ dkyil 'khor ram lha khang lta bur g.yas su bskor ba byed tshe skor mkhan rnams mdun gyi g.yas phyogs nas g.yon du gral rim sgrig dgos pa dper na yi ge drug ma sogs sngags 'phreng gi 'khor lo bzhin no// g.yon nas g.yas su gral rim bsgrigs na 'khor dus g.yon du bskor ba las ci yod/ g.yon skor yin tshad bon lugs su 'dod na shes rab gtso bor bton pa'i sngags 'phreng g.yon skor rnams kyang bon lugs su thal bas mi rung ngo*// spyir btang rang las rten rtsa che ba'i dbang du byas te mdun rten gyi g.yas phyogs nas mgo brtsams pa'ang don la 'thad cing yongs grags yin pas mgo gzhug log pa nyid du bsam mi rung*/ rang gi g.yas nas mgo brtsams pa de yang rgyu mtshan khyad par can gyi phyag srol yin pas gcig shes kyis mgo rting log pa nyid du 'dzin mi rung ngo*// des na skabs 'dir ni rang lugs gong smos bzhin rang gi g.yas sam mdun gyi g.yon phyogs nas mgo brtsams te g.yas phyogs su bsham par bya ba yin no// gzhan yang 'bras chan dkar gsum mngar gsum shing tog sogs gtsang zhing bsod pa'i kha zas mchod snod lhung bzed bcu bdun/

snod gzhan du dge bsnyen dharmā ta la gcig /rgyal chen bzhi la bzhi bshams par bya zhing*/ ha cang 'byor tshogs che bas ma shong ba'am lhung bzed kyis ma ldang na snod gzhan mang po'i nang du'ang phul rung zhing*/ ha cang 'byor pa chung bas ma lcogs na lhung bzed gcig tsam gyis kyang chog go// de ni nyin dgung gdugs tshod kyi tshul du phul ba'i zhal zas las sngags kyi cho ga ma yin pas/ sngags chog gzhan las rigs bsgres te gnas brtan gyi tshogs zhes brjod du mi rung bas shes par bya'o// khrus chas chu gtsang gi bum pa/ me long*/ sku phyis kyi dar/ chos gos sam dar gos la sogs pa'i na bza' yang 'du bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas logs su slob dpon chen po zhi ba dang khro bo gang rung gi sku rten bzhugs pa'i mdun drag dmar gyi mchod gtor/ sman raka /nyer spyad lnga/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon logs su mgon po lcam dral la sogs pa'i gtor ma so sor ram bsdu na spungs gtor/ mchod pa'ang de bzhin so sor ram bsdu na chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyad lnga/ sman raka dang gser skyems bcas bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab ngos su'ang mar me dang zhal zas sogs ci 'byor bshams/ bsdu na ci bde bar phyogs gcig tu thub dbang gnas brtan gyi mchod pa dang gtor ma/ phyogs gcig tu drag dmar dang gsol kha'i mchod gtor sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len bzhin bshams/ gang ltar yang mdzes shing bkod legs pa mchod pa'i mtshan nyid du gsungs pas de ltar bya'o// gnyis pa cho ga'i rim pa la gnyis/ thub dbang gnas brtan rnams mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa dang*/ drag dmar dang chos skyong gtor bsngos kyi rim pa gnyis so// dang po thub dbang gnas brtan rnams mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o//

zhes pa lan gsum/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bu brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la gsol ba 'debs// gang zhig phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i khungs// bstan pa rin chen phyag tu gtad pa de// chos bzhin byi dor mdzad pa'i dgra bcom pa// gnas brtan rgyal tshab rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shā ri bu dang mau'u 'gal gyi bu// kun dga' sgra gcan 'dzin dang ma 'gags pa// gang po rab 'byor 'od srung nye 'khor sogs// nyan thos grangs las 'das la gsol ba 'debs// mgon po klu sgrub ar+ya de wa dang*// thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags// chos skyob yon shāka rnam gnyis dpa' bo sogs// 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bstan la mdzad pa'i phul// ston pa nyi bzhin 'phyur ba rgya gar gyi// paṇ+ḍi ta dang gangs can ljongs byon pa'i// rgya bod mkhas grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug thams cad kyi// cod pan gcig pu gyur pa chos kyi rje// mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde byed pa po// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mi pham pad+ma dkar po chos kyi rgyal// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag paṇa chen 'gro ba'i mgon// snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa chos kyi rje// ngag dbang nor bu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i rlabs 'phreng dbus// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i 'dab stong rgyas pa la// pan bde'i dri bsung ci yang spro ba'i gnyen// ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pas ma rig mun pa'i tshogs 'joms shing*// brtses bas gzhan don yal bar mi 'dor bar// nus pas bdud dpung 'joms byed lha yi lha// ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khams gsum sems can 'khor ba las sgrol phyir// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog rab brnyes nas// 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// ji srid 'tsho zhing gzhes par gyur cig gu// tshul khrims rnam dag nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir// gzhan phan thugs kyi dpag bsam rab rgyas shing*// zung 'jug sngags kyi 'bras bu legs gtams pa'i// bsod nams 'od zer zhabs=

/shes bya kun gzigs dge legs du ma'i dpyid// phas rgol gnyis 'thung tshogs kyi klad 'gems pa'i// smra ba'i seṅge dpal ldan ngag gi dbang*// bstan 'dzin rab rgyas= /rgyal kun thugs rje'i gar bsgyur ngag gi dbang*// 'gro ba rnams la kun dga'i gnyen gcig pu// theg gsum chos kyi rgyal mtshan rtser son pa'i// kun dga' rgyal mtshan= /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gsum zhi khro ḍāk+ki srung ma'i tshogs// gsang gsum gnyug ma'i ngang du ro gcig pa'i// ngag dbang rgyal mtshan= /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso// mchog gsum kun 'dus mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// dri med rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba dngos// shākya rin chen=/ mdor na sman ljongs yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'dir// chos srid lung gis 'gro rnams bder 'tsho ba'i// bka' drin mtshungs med ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi// brgyud 'dzin bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu sku tshe ring bar gsol ba 'debs// 'phrin las dar zhing rgyas par gsol ba 'debs// bla ma dang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs// phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams// sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni// sdug bsngal sems can mthar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// chos bstan mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis/ dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o//

zhes pa'i mtshams 'dir tshugs rol bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ skyabs sems ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung khungs/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa lan gsum/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyid pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces pa lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom mo// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du thub dbang gnas brtan rnams mchod pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bgyi'o// de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te bsam pa rtse gcig pas 'di skad brjod par bya ste/

'di ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sngon byang chub sems dpa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthu chen po la brten nas/ deng 'dir rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams 'byon zhing bzhugs pa'i gnas 'di dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba/ yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung dang ldan pa/ lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyi gcal bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ mu tig gi phye ma gram bur brdal ba/ bdud rtsi'i chu klung dal gyis 'bab cing*/ lha'i me tog man+da ra ba dang*/ ut+pal dang*/ ku mu ta dang*/ pad+ma dkar po 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs pa'i rdzing bu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba rnams su chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan sgrogs pas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa me tog dang 'bras bus mdzes par lha'i nor bu dang*/ mu tig gi rgyan 'phreng dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs dpyangs pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer ga 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba mtshar du bsgrengs pas legs par brgyan pa'i dbus gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba'i brtsigs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig rmang nas nor bu rin po che snang ba thams cad rtsigs pa'i stegs bus bskor ba/

nor bu rin po che glog gi sgron mas spras pa/ 'dzam+bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi kha khyer la rin po che sna tshogs kyi chun pos mdzes pa/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i drwa bas bkab pa/ in+d+ra nī la'i shar bu dang karke ta'i mda' yab kyi 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan bsgreng ba/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can mang po btsugs pa/ rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas 'khor gyi khyams blta na sdug cing*/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i zhing khams thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs kyi khams las grub pa'i seṅge'i khri lha'i dar zab sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa rnam par thar pa las byung ba dang mtshungs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid can/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ byed las sgrib pa gsum sbyong bar byed pa/ yun 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'byung bar gyur cig /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sa ra pra marda ne/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ samyaka sam bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re/ mahā te dz+wa badz+re/ mahā bid+ya ba dz+re/ mahā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi man+t+ro pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ni badz+re swāhā/ zhes sil snyan dang bcas lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum yod pa'i dang po spyan 'dren pa ni/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa// pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du// thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams// rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams// 'khor dang bcas te gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skems shing*// rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bka' sdod pa'i// nyan thos dge 'dun gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i dbang gi nyan thos tshul 'dzin cing*// khyad par can gyi 'phrin las chos skyong ba'i// gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs// dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshig bsnyen pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal// bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na/

'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs pa ltar 'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs nas rang rang gi gdan la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa ni/ dbus su seṅge'i khri pad zla'i gdan dang bcas pa la/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa chen po sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'doms gang gis brgyan pa/ 'od zer nyi ma stong bas lhag pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas bzang ba/ shin tu zhi ba'i spyod lam gyis mdzes pa/ chos gos rnam pa gsum legs par bgos pas na/ gser gyi ri bo mtshams gyi sprin pas 'khyud pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas pa gser gyi mdog can glang po'i sna zhags ltar brkyang ba'i sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar zhing 'bar ba'i gtsug tor mthon mthing sems can gyis bltar mi mngon pa/ gser gyi 'khor los mtshan gyis mdzes pa'i zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs par gyur/ phyi bskor gyi pad+ma rnams la shar nas rim pa bzhin g.yas bskor gyis/ gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin phyag gnyis rin po che'i srog gzhu bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len phyag g.yas glegs bam g.yon mnyam bzhag tu lhung bzed bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam brtan phyag g.yas glegs bam g.yon chos 'chad kyi mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde phyag g.yas bum pa g.yon 'khar bsil bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po sbed byed phyag gnyis glegs bam bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa phyag gnyis byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na spos phor dang mchan khung g.yon na rnga yab bsnams pa/

gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ gnas brten chen po nags na gnas phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po dus ldan phyag na gser gyi rna sgor bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po bzang po phyag g.yas chos 'chad g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ gnas brtan chen po gser be'u phyag na rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ku la phyag na ne'u le bsnams pa/ de thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtags mdzes shing gtsang ba'i chos gos gsum gyis klubs shing dgra bcom gnas brtan dbang po dul ba'i cha lugs can rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ shar sgo'i nang khyams kyi gdan la dge bsnyen chen po dharmā ta rnga yab dang bum pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra thor cog can/ sde snod kyi glegs bam mang po 'khur ba/ dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la gzigs shing*/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag sprul pa'o// shar sgor rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa| lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan dang ne'u le 'dzin pa rnams rgyan dang cha lugs phun sum tshogs pa/ rang rang gi 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos la sogs pa dpag tu med pa ngo mtshar gyi rnam 'phrul du ma 'gyed cing phyi nang kun tu sprin gyi phung po ltar 'thibs pa dang*/ sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba/

dam pa'i chos thos pa/ lha klu gnod sbyin rigs sngags 'chang grub pa mi'am ci dang nam mkha' lding la sogs pa 'byung po chen po rnams kyang dam pa'i chos gnas par bya ba dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams bsrung zhing skyong ba'i phyir nam mkha'i lam dang gzhal med khang gi phyi rol kun tu 'khod par gyur/ zhes bzhugs su gsol lo// gnyis pa khrus dang phyag mchod sogs 'bul ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'khor 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dang bcas pa rnams la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// zhes snyan gsan dbab/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nyid kyis// de bzhin gshegs kun bkrus gyur pa// de bzhin bdag gis lha rnams la// gtsang ma'i chab kyi khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūṃ/ ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi// yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa// mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la// bdag gi khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūṃ/ sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gnas dang ni// slob pa'i dge 'dun gnas kyi sa// gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhan la// bdag gi khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūṃ/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swāhā/

yun ring gnas par mdzod// phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams// sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig

/chos rnga chen po sgra yis ni// sdug bsngal sems can mthar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang*// bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig / ces sogs gnas brtan phyag mchod du grags pa'i bstod pa yang ci rigs 'don pa'i mthar// gsol 'debs kyi bsnyen pa dngos ni 'dun pa rtse gcig pas 'di ltar bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong zhing lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal zhing du/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bka' bsgos te/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten na mngon sum du bzhugs shing bka' lung gi rjes su sgrub par 'phags pa'i tshig nges pas zhal gyis bzhes pa/ pri yaṅku yi gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan zin 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bya rgod phung po ri la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang drug brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shar gyi lus 'phags gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

ri'i rgyal po ngos yangs la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ri'i rgyal po bhe'u lar 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sbed byed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ri'i rgyal po gangs can la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gangs ri chen po ti se la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung 'khor dgra bcom pa stong sum brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ drang srong ri'i ngogs na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa 'khor dgra bcom pa brgya phrag gcig gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ri nags kyi ngogs lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zangs gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dus ldan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ siṅga la'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

chu bo ya mu na'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bzang po 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ kha che'i yul na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po gser be'u 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ nub kyi ba lang spyod na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can 'khor dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ku la 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharmā ta 'khor dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes ci nus su gsol ba gdab bo// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang nyid thub par gsal ba'am/ yang na mdun gyi gtso 'khor rnams la dmigs pa'i dad mos drag pos thugs dam bskul ba'i tshul du/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu ni shākya mu na ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags gtso sngags ci nus su bzla'o// smon lam chen mo'i skabs 'di nas bzang spyod smon lam gsog /de nas thub dbang mchog dang gnas bcu'i gsol ba 'bul tshul ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛta sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+gate s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan bdun nam gsum gyis nam mkha' khyab par spel/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun nam gsum gyis so so'i thugs dang mthun par sbar nas/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa// mchog tu gyur pa'i zas mchog 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// rnal 'byor ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /rgyal bas bdud bcom byang chub sangs rgyas te/ rgyal ba'i sku la sbrebs skyems mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag bsod nams zhing du 'gyur slad du// kha dog dri dang ro brgya ldan pa yi// sbyar ba'i bshos dang zhal zas 'di phul bas// dus kun dge ba'i lo tog 'phel rgyas nas// bde ba can du pad+mo las skyes te// ting 'dzin zas dang chos la longs spyod shog / spro na mdzad bcu'i gsol 'debs 'don/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te spa ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum/ a kā ros sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// tshim zhing dgyes par rol la sngon tshe ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan sngar zhal gyis 'ches pa bzhin sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams bsrung zhing skyong ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol//
gzhi bdag gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛta sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ a ka ros lan gsum gyis bsngos/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid/ stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang bye brag 'dzam bu'i gling*/ khyad par kha ba can dang kha bzhi lho'i rgyal khams/ yang sgos sa phyogs 'di dag tu gnyug mar gnas shing dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'phrog ma ma bu 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa ston pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i lha klu 'byung po mthu bo che sde dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams bsrung zhing*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang bdag cag gi bsam don chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// cha gsum ni/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bdag cag pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal sbyar khyed rnams la yang gsol 'debs na// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams// gsan nas phan 'dogs slad du 'dir spyon cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yul kun gnas dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i gyim rnams dang*// grong khyer kun na gang dag gnas pa dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnangs dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// rdzing dang mtsho dang lu ma lteng ka dang*// khron pa dang ni ngam grog chu mig dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas dang ni nags tshal dang*// khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang*// gang dag gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas// bsod nams khyim dang glang po'i khang rnams dang*// gang dag rgyal po'i dkor khang gnas pa dang*// srang dang khyams dang grong gi mdun sa dang*// gang dag shing gcig drung dang lam chen gnas// dur khrod dang ni nags tshal che gnas dang*// seng ge glang chen dred kyi gnas rnams dang*// gang dag 'jigs rung dgon pa che gnas dang*// chu gling mchog dag tu ni gnas byas dang*// gang dag 'brog dgon dur khrod dag na gnas// dga' zhing mgu nas dri ma me tog 'phreng*// spos dang me tog mar me gus phul ba// 'di dag snoms te so sor bzhes nas kyang*// las 'di dag gi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// hūṃ|

shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs bcas// gtor ma phul 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag/ chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams ma lus sa yi klu bdag dang*// ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus la// so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di bzhes la// rang rang gis ni phyogs su bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad grogs dang g.yog 'khor dag /dpung dang sder bcas mnyes nas gshegs su gsol// spos dang me tog gtor ma zhal zas ni// 'di dag bzhes shing so sor bsnams nas kyang*// bya ba 'di ni 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// hūṃ| gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing 'gel ba sogs gnas pa// de dag de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug dang*// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po dang*// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i phyir// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// gsum pa rjes chog las mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad du lha mi'i mchod rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ gzungs dang*/ rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste 'byung bar gyur cig /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sa ra pra marda ne/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ samyag sam bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re/ mahā te dz+wa badz+re/

mahā bid+ya badz+re/ mahā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi man+t+ro pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ni badz+re swāhā/ bstod pa ni/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bu brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod// gang zhig phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i khungs// bstan pa rin chen phyag tu gtad pa de// chos bzhin byi dor mdzad pa'i dgra bcom pa// gnas brtan rgyal tshab rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed pa// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dod don la gsol ba btab pa ni/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug gis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// thugs rje'i bdag nyid gnas brtan bcu drug gis// 'khor tshogs srid mtsho las brgal nyon mongs med// khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// sems can kun gyi gsos gyur dgra bcom pa// rig dang zhabs ldan skye dgu'i sbyin gnas che// 'phags pa'i gang zag chen po khyed rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// thub dbang gnas brtan chen po 'khor bcas la// mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi zhabs brtan cing*// mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// dge 'dun sde rnams bslab gsum yon tan ldan// 'jig rten kun tu phan bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas// rnyed dang bkur stis rtag tu mchod byed cing*// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes gsol ba btab bo// ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*// cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*// bdag gis brjed ngas ci bgyid pa// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// ces lhag chad bskang zhing bzod par gsol/ de nas mdun du spyan drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub bstsal// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol// ces dang*/ sku gzugs rnams la dmigs te/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams sbyin par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ bcom ldan 'das gnas brtan 'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa la brten nas sprul pa'i gzugs kyis rten dang gnyis su med par ji srid gnas kyi bar du bzhugs shing*/ sku dngos rnams bdag gi bsod nams spel ba'i slad du yang dang yang du 'byon zhing gdan 'dzom par zhal gyis 'ches te dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing gzhan du tshad med pa'i 'gro ba'i don du yud kyi gshegs par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thub dbang 'khor bcas 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa| |de yi sa la 'god par shog /khyed la mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su// nad gdon dbul 'phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang*// chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod nas/ bzang spyod smon lam ni/ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bha dra tsar+ya pra ṇi d+dhā na rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/

dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dwangs bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// me tog dam pa 'phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron me rnams// byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi// 'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur// gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur ba// bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon// phyogs bcu ga la'i zhing rnams ji snyed pa// de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur// byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang*// sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog/

phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa// de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur// 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni// mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing*// 'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par gyur// tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na// rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*// tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa// rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam par// thams cad skad du bdag gis chos ston to// des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te// byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur// sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur ba dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las// grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang*// ji ltar pad+mo chus mi chags pa bzhin// nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad// zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par// ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed// bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*// 'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad// byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*// sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing*// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par gyur// bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa// de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang*// spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad// bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams// de dag dang yang rtag tu 'phrad par shog

/de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung*// sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams// mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal bar blta// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar// de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi// rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing*// byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed// bzang po spyod pa rnam par spyad pa yang*// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi// srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na// bsod nams ye shes dang ni mi zad brnyes// thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang*// yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod gyur cig /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te// zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la// byang chub spyod pa spyad cing blta bar bgyi// de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang*// skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad rnyed kyi// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang*// bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis// rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa// 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs// sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi// de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la// blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang*// skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi// gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni bzhugs par spyad// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang*// de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta// rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la// sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa// de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par bsgrub// de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du// rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug

/gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron ma rnams// de dag rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor// mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston// mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o// kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang*// kun nas sgo yi theg pa'i stobs dag dang*// kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang*// kun tu khyab pa byams pa dag gi stobs// kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs dag dang*// chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs// shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis// byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed// las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing*// nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms par byed// bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing*// bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi// zhing khams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*// sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par dgrol// chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing*// ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed// spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*// smon lam rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par byed// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing*// bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi// gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yi// byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams// bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas// de kun bdag gis ma lus rdzogs par bgyi// rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa// gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya// mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing*// spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag par// bsngo ba bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra ba// de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad pa'i phyir// 'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar// de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi// spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig

/yon tan rnams kyang tshad bzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang*// de dag 'khrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par// sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te// ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa// bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo// gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa// rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog rnams kyang*// zhing gi rdul rnyed bskal par phul ba bas// gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas// byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab mos shing*// lan gcig tsam yang dad pa skyed pa ni// bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu'ang 'di 'gyur ro// gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pas// des ni ngan song thams cad spangs par 'gyur// des ni grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin// snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong*// de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho// mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong*// kun tu bzang po de yang ci 'dra bar// de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur// mtshams med lnga po dgi sdig pa rnams// gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na// myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur// ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang*// rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur// bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mi thub// 'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur// byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro// song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste// byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu bskor// bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul// gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di// 'chang ba dang ni ston tam klog pa yis// de yi rnam par smin pa'ang sangs rgyas mkhyen// byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig

/'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi// bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na// sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te// mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas// bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro// der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang*// thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog/ de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bkang*// 'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas// sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis// blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang*// sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bton pa yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// des ni 'gro ba'i smon lam dge ba rnams// skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shog /gang yang bzang po spyod pa 'di bsngos pas// bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa gang thob des// 'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba rnams// 'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso// mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing*// kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub ste// ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stongs par shog /

'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs so// ༈ byams smon ni/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang*// nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan 'gro'i lam ni bzlog bgyid cing*// mtho ri lam ni rab ston la// rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa'i// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa| |sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi// bdag la rnam pa gsum gang gis// bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa de// bdag ni kun mkhyen sa bon te// bdag gi byang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing khams su// sangs rgyas mchod pa gang byung ba// sangs rgyas mkhyen pas yi rang ba// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo*// sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni ye shes mchog thob shog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams na/ sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par bskul ma 'debs// byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing*// sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas// srog chags kun la sman slad du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni// sdug bsngal sems can mthar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'dod pa'i 'dam du byin gyur cing*// sred pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa// 'ching ba kun gyis bcings bdag la// rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs su gsol// sems kyi dri mar gyur pa la// sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mdzad// sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang*// gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa// de dag rjes su bdag slob cing*// byang chub spyad pa spyod gyur cig

/pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas// 'gro drug sems can thar bgyid shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas// bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang*// rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma mchis/ rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis// stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar// sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis// gang zag ma mchis gso ma mchis/ bdag ma mchis pa'i chos rtogs shog/ bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin pa ni// dngos po kun la mi gnas par// sems can kun la phan slad du// ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong shog/ dngos po dngos por ma mchis pas// bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pa'i// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa 'am yang na chu 'am me// rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shing*// bzod pa khro ba ma mchis pas// bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// brtan spro le lo ma mchis shing*// stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang*// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang*// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang*// dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang yang*// rig gsum mngon sum bgyis pa yis// shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi bsngags pa dang*// 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis// bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar spyad pa spyod byed cing*// byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas// sa bcu po la rab tu gnas//

kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa gang la gnas nas thabs mkhas pas theg pa bde ba dang*/ 'jug pa bde ba dang*/ lam bde bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrub pa'i thabs mkhas pa ni 'di yin no// 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs so// de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dpag med kyis// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro lha ma yin// gnas ngan len par rtag tu spangs byas nas// rgyal ba byams pa'i zhabs drung skye bar shog / 'phro mthud de snying po don gsum las grub chen mi tra dzo kis mdzad ces byung*/ dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang na// rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po bzhugs// sa bcu gnas pa'i 'khrungs sa yin// zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog /tshe 'di'i nyin byed 'chi bdag mun nag gis// rnam par zos tshe rang blo'i nam mkha' la// byams mgon thugs rje'i zla ba de shar nas// dga' ldan bgrod pa'i lam chen mthong bar shog /de nas rje btsun zhabs la dad pa dang*// mi phyed smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar nas// theg mchog chos kyi dga' bas tshim bzhin du// shin sbyangs 'dab stong rgyas pa'i dpal thob shog /mgon khyod rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas nas// theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe// 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du bdag gyur te// byang chub dam pa lung bstan thob gyur cig / spro na byang chub ltung bshags dang smon lam yongs rdzogs cha tshang ngam re mos kyi 'don pa gang rung gis dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher bsngo ba byas te/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma 'dab 'dra rgyas pa'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/

dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yis// 'phrin las bsgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med/ skal ba mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje yis// nyan thos tshul du srid pa ji srid bar// bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu kun la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol nor lha'i bkra shis shog/ lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i skyon dang bral ba dang*// 'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yis// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos shing*// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog

/yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral 'khrul med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang*// bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin slob dpon bzhin du mthun pa yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog / des thub dbang gnas brtan rnams mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa rdzogs so/// /gnyis pa drag dmar dang chos skyong gtor bsngos kyi rim pa ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/ bstod tshogs ni/ sngon tshe snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med// ri bo ta lar mgon po spyan ras gzigs// ngha na ko shar o rgyan pad+ma 'byung*// sku gsum dbyer med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgya gar paṇa chen bod la bka' drin che// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la 'das 'khrungs med// da lta lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// mi pham pad+ma dkar po chos kyi rgyal// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag paṇa chen 'gro ba'i mgon// snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa chos kyi rje// ngag dbang nor bu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i rlabs 'phreng dbus// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i 'dab stong rgyas pa la// phan bde'i dri bsung ci yang spro ba'i gnyen// ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pas ma rig mun pa'i tshogs 'joms shing*// brtse bas gzhan don yal bar mi 'dor bar// nus pas bdud dpung 'joms byed lha yi lha// ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khams gsum sems can 'khor ba las sgrol phyir// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog rab brnyes nas// 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// ji srid 'tsho zhing gzhes par gyur cig gu// rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan 'jig rten dbang*// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro ba 'dul mdzad du// gdung 'dir sprul pa dgu ru lung bstan pa'i// snying po'i gsal byed gnyis par gsol ba 'debs// zhing 'di'i gdul bya ma lus mthar son phyir// nyi zla'i bgrod pa'i 'pho ba kun bcom nas// nyi khri chig stong nghū ti'i dbyings su sad// rdo rje lta bu'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// gang zhig shes bya ma lus mkhyen brtse'i bdag

/'gro mang gang 'dul gtsug lag gzhung lugs kun// rab gsal sgrib bral chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed// khyod gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam nyid klong las mi 'gal du ma'i gar// gcig tu bstan pa mngon par byang chub tu// 'char mdzad zung 'jug lam gyi mgon gcig pu// khyod thugs sgrib gnyis bral la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// yongs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs brtan zhing*// bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa'i zhing rnams la// theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan pa 'byung ba dang*// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i phyir// mtshungs med bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan zhing*// mdzad pa 'phrin las rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// gang la gang 'dul bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu sku tshe ring bar gsol ba 'debs// 'phrin las dar zhing rgyas par gsol ba 'debs// bla ma dang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs// phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams// sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni// sdug bsngal sems can mthar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// chos bstan mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'au// brgyud 'debs ni/ snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs dang pad+ma 'byung*// chos longs sprul pa'i skur bzhengs grags pa'i gzhi// pad+ma dkar po bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// ngag dbang rnam rgyal la sogs bla ma yi// zhabs zung byang chub snying po de tshun du// bdag gi spyi bo'i nor bu nyid gyur cig

/ lan gsum/ skyabs sems ni/ bdag ni mgon po gzhan spangs nas// rig 'dzin chen po khyed la skyabs// de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod// sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun lags so// de'i phyir thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis// rnam pa kun tu gzigs pa dang*// khyed kyi mdzad pa gang lags pa// de la bdag gis bslab par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ bgegs gtor ni/ oṃ ā:hūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ a ka ro lan gsum gyis bsngos te hūṃ| nga ni yak+ṣa me sbal te// pad+ma dbang gi pho nya ba// bar chad byed pa'i bgegs thams cad// rgya mtsho'i mtha' la skrod par 'ongs// su zhig nga yi tshig 'da' ba// de'i lus sems rdul du rlog /de 'dra'i nyen la ma bsdo bar// 'dod pa'i mchod sbyin 'di khyer la// khor yug ri bo'i skyobs la bros// oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes bskrad/ mtshams gcod ni/ hūṃ| chos kun ye dag ye rdzogs la// bdud dang log 'dren gdon bgegs ci// glo bur rkyen gyis ci bzos kyang*// ka dag dbyings las g.yos pa med// oṃ ā:hūṃ/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ dngos gzhi'i lha bdag mdun gnyis med 'don pa gcig gis gsal gdab pa 'di ltar/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dhārmaḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho ྅haṃ/ ye dag ye rdzogs chen po'i klong*/ dran rig ye shes kyi cha/ rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma drag po rtsal/ bskal pa'i me'i bong dang mdangs dang gzi brjid 'dzin pa/ zhal gnam sa tsam du gdangs shing mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ mid pa stong gsum tsam brgyangs pa'i ya rkan la nyi ma kā lis mtshan pa/ ma khal la zla ba ā lis mtshan pa/ ljags kyi rtse rta gdong gi me lce lta bur bskyod pa'i rtsa ba hūṃ la/ oṃ aḥhū?ṃ ar tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru dmar po 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba lta bu'i sgra grags bzhin pas bskor ba/

dmar ba'i spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sprul pa'i lcags sdig mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa bsnams pas gdug pa can thams cad gzir ba/ dpal gyi chas kyis legs par brgyan pa/ sku smad chu srin khros pa'i kha nas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur bu dbal gsum rtse mo gcig tu rno ba/ nang khong seng can/ dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed gser mdog can g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po g.yas dbyug tho 'phyar ba/ brang dbus kyi thad kyi nang du dregs pa phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ gsang gnas su khro bo yak+ṣa me sbal smug nag g.yas tho ba 'phyar ba/ de thams cad g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub/ shin tu khro la dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan cing*/ g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ lte bar rdo rje phag mo dmar mo g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gcer mo chags pa rgyas pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ thod kyi mgo bo rnams kyi dbus ma la bud+dha thod 'phreng rtsal/ g.yas su rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal dang rat+na thod 'phreng rtsal/ g.yon du pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal dang karma thod 'phreng rtsal/ dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba/ thams cad zhi ma khro za 'og smug po'i ber lhub gyon du mdzad cing rus pa dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dbu la sha ba'i snyan zhu rgod kyi rtse khru dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba gsol zhing*/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod khrag dkur brten pas rang rigs kyi yum gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa la 'khyud de rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ 'tshogs mar sprul pa'i khyung mthing nag gdug pa can gyi klu zas su za ba/ spyi bo'i bu gar gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/

mig sna rna ba kha lte ba brgyad du rnam rgyal/ gshin rje gshed/ rta mgrin/ bgegs mthar byed/ dbyug sngon can/ mi g.yo ba/ 'dod rgyal/ stobs po che/ phur pa'i dbal gyi nang rtser gnod mdzes/ thams cad khro bo'i chas can lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang thams cad mthing kha/ tsit+ta rin po che'i gur khyim du zla ba la gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i dbus na gnas pa/ de'i gnas so so'i lha las 'od 'phros/ rnga yab gling gi pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang sogs phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ slob dpon chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkon mchog gsum du rnam par rol pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam ste rol dbyangs dang bcas/ hūṃ| 'di nas nyi ma lho nub phyogs shed na// o rgyan sprul sku'i zhing khams rnga yab gling*// rak+ṣa mi zan rnams kyi rgyal po'i khab// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang dang*// phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad nas// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur mi zad pa'i// rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsang ba'i mtshan gsol gu ru drag po rtsal// ma rung gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// rnal 'byor bar chad sel phyir gshegs su gsol// dad ldan byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de'i mod la slob dpon chen po'i sku zhi khro'i sangs rgyas thams cad du snang ba/ gsung gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags thams cad du grags pa'i yig 'bru/ thugs ting nge 'dzin phyag rgya thams cad du 'char ba/ steng nas char babs pa lta bu/ 'og nas sa rlangs thon pa lta bu/ bar nas bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad mer mer yom yom shig shig byon nas/ bdag gi lus lhar gsal ba dang*/ ngag sngags su gsal ba dang*/ yid phyag rgyar gsal ba la rim rim thim par gyur/ ces brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ar tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ ka ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wak+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes 'dzab nyer gcig gam bdun cis kyang bzla'o// de nas dbang sgrub lha lnga la gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ kyai| dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rje// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i che mchog he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sku mchog 'gyur med bud+dha thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i bud+dha he ru ka

/'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gsung mchog 'gag med pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i pad+ma he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// thugs mchog dri med badz+ra thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i badz+ra he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// yon tan kun rdzogs rat+na thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i rin chen he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'phrin las thogs med karma thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i karma he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de nas*/ dbang sgrub kyi lha tshogs snyoms par zhugs pas/

bde ba rgyas te sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa dpag tu med pa babs/ bdag gi spyi bor bye ma la chu btab pa lta bur zhugs/ spyi bo gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang dbang thob/ snying ga gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag / dbang gsum pa thob/ lte ba gang*/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus thams cad gang ba'i rgyun spyi bor lud pas/ ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i dbus su snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa sku'i cha lugs can du gyur par bsam/ mchod pa ni/ kyai| lha rdzas me tog kun gyis nam mkha' bkab// dri zhim bdug spos bsregs pas sa gzhi bkang*// snang gsal 'od gsal phyogs bcu'i mthar 'brel ba// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// sim skyed bdud rtsi byugs pa'i chu 'dzin g.yos// bda' dgu'i zhal zas thams cad char du babs// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog pa rnams// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// mdzes ma bro brdung snyan pa'i glu blangs mthar// dri zhim ngad 'gyed ma mchu'i sbrang sbyin nas// reg mthar bde ba bha gas ston pa rnams// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// myos byed dpa' bo'i dam rdzas phud chen 'thor// snang srid ma mo'i mchod rdzas rak+ta sbreng*// thun mong mnyes pa'i bā ling cher bshams pa// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// bstod pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas sku yi 'phro 'du las// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i khro rgyal drag po rtsal// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do lus la byin gyis rlobs// snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi 'phro 'du las// gsang ba 'dus pa'i sngags rgod dmod pa'i mtshon// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do ngag la byin gyis rlobs// snang ba mtha' yas thugs kyi 'phro 'du las// sor rtog ye shes rdzogs pa chen po'i klong*// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do yid la byin gyis rlobs//

bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ar tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar stong 'gyur brjod/ gsol 'debs rnam gsum ni/ e ma ho: spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su: chos nyid dus gsum skye 'gag med pa'i ngang : bya bral lhun rdzogs bde ba chen po'i sku: nam mkha' bzhin du thugs rje phyogs ris med: bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs: bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams su: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi: ye shes lnga ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i sku: thugs rje bye brag sna tshogs so sor ston: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs: mi mjed 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing khams su: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la byon: gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad: 'das dang ma byon da ltar dus gsum gyi: bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: chos sku kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs: longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsol ba 'debs: sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po la gsol ba 'debs: chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan la = mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la = sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms la = lha sras mu khri btsan po la = rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug la = mi pham chos kyi rgyal po la = mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma la = rgyal sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal la = drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'jig rten dbang phyug= /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i=/ phan bde'i dri bsung =/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal=/ mkhyen pas ma rig=/ brtse bas gzhan don=/ nus pas bdud dpung =/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal=/ khams gsum sems can=/ 'chi med rdo rje'i=/ 'phrin las rnam bzhis=/ ji srid 'tsho zhing =/

skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// gang la gang 'dul bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bdag ni skyabs gzhan spangs nas khyod kho na'i// zhabs pad 'di nas bzung ste gar skyes sar// mchod do mgon nyid gang du gshegs pa'i sar// myur bar khrid cig gu ru rin po che// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs myur thob shog /hūṃ: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu'i dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: dur khrod rus chen rgyan cha khro lo lo: sgra dang rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs hū?ṃ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro sde lngas gar byed shigs se shig: ging chen dpa' bo'i bro brdung khrab se khrab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: chos skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu kyu ru ru: hūṃ gi snang glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad drag po sangs se sang: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: thugs rjes gzigs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : bdag cag byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang :

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: thal sbyar bcas/ rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i blos// spro ba'i snyim pa dang bcas pas// rab tu btud de gus phyag 'tshal// dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul// phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa// mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun// rnam pa kun tu mchod pa 'bul// thogs med dus nas bsags pa yi// thun mong khyad par dang 'gal ba'i// mi dge bcu sogs nyes pa'i tshogs// ma lus 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bshags// nam mkha'i mthar thug phyogs kun tu// 'gro la phan par mdzad pa yi// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la// dga' ba'i sems kyis rjes yi rang*// sna tshogs tshul gyis gdul bya la// rang rang bsam pa ji lta bar// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// theg chen chos 'khor bskor du gsol// sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las kyi// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// ji srid 'khor ba de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gzhan kun gyis bsags pa yi// dus gsum dge ba gcig bsdus nas// mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub snying por thob phyir bsngo// nam mkha'i dbyings rnams kun nas gang ba'i spos kyi chu gter 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin rgyas pas khyab pa'i snying po nor bu'i khor yug gi /nang na zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sa gzhi rin chen las grub rim gyis gzhol ba bkod legs ma lus bkod pa'i phud kyis 'jig rten khams re re'ang 'dod yon rmad byung 'phyur ba gang*/ mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing gis bskor zhing kun bzang mchod sprin ma tshang med pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i rdul rer rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa thams cad snang ba can/ gcig tu 'du zhing so sor ma 'dres byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin de dag bdag gis dge ba'i sems kyis sprul te dpal ldan bla mar dad pas 'bul bar bgyi'/ོ/

zhing khams rgya mtshor rdul rer rdul snyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// kun gyis brgyan ldan ji snyed 'od 'phro'i rtser// rgyal ba sras bcas rnam thar kun snang zhing*// 'khor zhi'i 'dod dgu ma tshang med 'dus pa// chos dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'phrul// nam mkha'i khams khyab srid pa'i mthar gnas nas// chos kyi rgyal po mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ mnyes byas maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /e ma ho: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i byin rlabs g.yos: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas byin rlabs te: 'dzam gling bod kyi sems can don la byon: 'gro don rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal po khri srong lde btsan man chad nas: chos rgyal gdung brgyud mtha' la ma stongs par: dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs: bod kyi chos skyong rgyal po'i gnyen gcig pu: rgyal po chos spyod skyob pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :sku ni lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can don la dgongs: ma rig log pa'i sems can 'dren pa'i dpal: nyon mongs gdul dka'i sems can thabs kyis 'dul: brtse gdung rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i tshe: nang re dgongs re bod kyi don la byon: nyi zer 'char dus mdangs la chibs te byon: yar ngo tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can:
