o rgyan= :bsam pa= :lnga brgya mtha' ma dus kyi snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga hrags: nyon mongs byol nyog dug lnga rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na pad 'byung thugs rje bskyed: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyen po 'jigs la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: pad 'byung lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: dmag dpung hur thum bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung nas: mi bzod sdug bsngal chen pos non pa'i tshe: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung sman gyi lha dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa yis: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis gzir ba'i tshe: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor: dbul phongs bkres skom sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'dod na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :sbas yul nags rong dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha ba bu yug 'tshub cing lam 'gag na: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor bcas kyis: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan= :bsam pa = :stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshe: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung dpa' bo'i ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus 'jigs shing nyen pa'i dus byung na: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung 'byung bzhi'i lha mor bcas pa yis:

'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :lam sang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: rtso ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgya= :bsam pa= :gang zhig gshed ma'i mi yis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon po 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma dred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung na: gnad gcod sdug bsngal 'du 'phros nyen pa na: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang grol ston par the tshom med: o rgyan= :bsam pa = :gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen pa'i sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis= :pad 'byung bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul snang rtsad nas bshig par byed: o rgyan= :bsam pa= :'gro drug sdug bsngal chen pos nyen pa dang : khyad par bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na: dad gus mos pa'i gdung bas gsol 'debs kyi: pad 'byung thugs rje 'pho 'gyur med par gzigs: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūṃ:

brgya rtsa bzlas mthar stong 'gyur brjod/ 'di nas bzang spyod gsog /mgon po lcam dral gyi gsol kha ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang*// pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan steng du/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i rwa gur dang*// mtshon cha ye shes me dpung 'bar bas dkrigs// de dbus oṃ las rnam snang rang bzhin gyi// gzhal med khang mchog dur khrod brgyad dang bcas// sku gsung thugs 'khor rim bzhin rin po che// lnga dang dkar dmar sngo ba'i nor bu dang / thod pa skam rnying rlon gsum las grub pa'i// zhi dang drag po'i rgyan ldan gru bzhi dang*// sgo bzhi mtshan nyid kun rdzogs zhag dang khrag /klad pa'i mtsho bcas dbus su bde chen 'khor// gru bzhi gling dgu zlum bskor e dbyibs dbus// 'dab brgyad pad nyi baṃ chen gdan bcas dang*// lha gnas rnams su hūṃ mthing yongs gyur las// dbus su ye shes mgon po sku mdog nag /phyag bzhi be 'bras thod khrag ral gri dang*// rtse gsum 'dzin cing drag po'i cha lugs rdzogs// rol stabs pang du yum chen tsaṇ+ḍi ka /gri thod 'dzin 'khyud ye shes me dbus bzhugs// g.yas g.yon dbyings sgrol 'dab bzhir re ti bzhi// zur gsum rigs gsum zla gam yum chen gsum// gru bzhir las mgon sde bzhi rang g.yon yum// gling brgyad mgon po bka' brgyad yum dang bcas// sgo mtshams brgyad du gdong can gsung 'khor khyams// nang mar 'jigs byed chen po brgyad dang ni// phyi rim zhing skyong nyer bzhi sgo skyong bzhi// rang rang yab bcas sku yi 'khor lo'i nang*// sde brgyad mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas dang*// phyi khyams phyogs skyong bcu dang sgo bzhi ru// rgyal chen bzhi rnams rang rigs sde dpung gis// yongs bskor dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs gsal// gnas bzhir 'bru bzhi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// lha mo bzhi bskul sprul pa'i tshogs spros pas// phyogs bcu'i zhing nas dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ma lus sprin phung gtibs bzhin spyan drangs gyur// hūṃ|

chos dbyings 'og min zhing dang rdo rje'i gdan// nā lan+ḍa sogs gnas dang dur khrod brgyad// nyer bzhi'i yul dang rang rang gnas mchog nas// 'khor bcas 'bod kyis ma g.yel da tshur byon// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la su tri ya ma du dzaḥ 'bar ba'i gdan bzhugs phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul// dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam ye gnyis med gyur// dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur gtso bo la// bde mchog 'khor rnams gtso bos dbu brgyan gyur// 'khor bcas sngon gyi dam dgongs las ma g.yel// sgo gsum gus pas 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥte hūṃ/ na mā mi hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ/ mchod rdzas thams cad oṃ gyis rab sbyangs shing*// āḥyig gis spel hūṃ gis bdud rtsir sbar// las bzhi rab 'byams de de'i rdzas 'char ba'i// bla med mchod pa'i sprin phung chen por gyur// hūṃ| kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i 'jing// nam mkha'i mdzod kyi nor bus yongs gang zhing*// khams gsum 'gugs pa'i 'od phreng gshin rje'i khab// ji bzhin bdud sde'i snying la 'jigs skyed 'bul// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin/ pād+yeṃ= /puṣ+pe= /nghū pe= /a loke= /gan+dhe = /nai wi d+yaṃ= /shap+ta pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ| dam rdzas bdud rtsi rak+ta bde ba'i mchod// las bzhi'i bkod pa dang mtshams bā ling+ta*// 'bru gsum sbyangs rtogs sbar bas mkha' dbyings kun// yongs gang dam can rgya mtsho mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra te s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa rnams re res 'bul/ oṃ mahā kā la ya shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e ṣa a paṣi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/

ya di pra tī dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ sa twa na/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūṃ phaṭa hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis thugs dkyil ba la 'bul/ oṃ ka ka ke dh+ya na/ ba ba ban+dha na/ kha kha kha da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭa naṃ/ ha na ha na| ghā ta ya ghā ta ya a mu ka s+ya/ shīn+taṃ ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswāhā/ gsung dkyil ba rnams la 'bul/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba ngharmā ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na tota oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ sku dkyil ba rnams la 'bul/ spro na 'dod gsol rgyas pa ni/ dpal mahā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad sgrol ba'i dpa' bo/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa skyong ba dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha chen po/ legs ldan rdo rje srin po bya rog gi ming can/ yum chen pe tā li/ e ka dzā ṭi/ dud pa'i sol ba ma/ re ma ti mched bzhi/ hūṃ mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po/ myur mdzad dam tshig gi mgon po/ gsang ba'i mgon po/ 'jigs byed kyi mgon po las mkhan chen po/ gsod byed kyi mgon po/ rngam byed kyi mgon po/ sgrol byed kyi mgon po/ ye shes kyi ma gsum/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka 'bar ba'i gdong*/ las kyi ma mo gsum/ sku'i mgon po stag zhon yab yum/ gsung gi mgon po agho ra yab yum/ thugs kyi mgon po nag po chen po 'bar ba yab yum/ yon tan gyi mgon po legs ldan yab yum/ 'phrin las kyi mgon po gri gug yab yum/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi mgon po beng yab yum/ rbod gtong gi mgon po ma ning yab yum/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i mgon po traka shad yab yum ste mgon po bka' brgyad/ sgo mtshams skyong ba'i lha mo brgyad/ rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi/ zhing skyong chen po so gnyis srid pa'i rgyal mo dang ber nag can/

bkris tshe ring ma dang tshogs kyi bdag po/ ral gcig g.yu'i sgron ma dang rta nag dregs pa chen po/ dur khrod bdag mo yab dang bcas pa/ lha'i mgon po gur lang dbang phyug chen po/ bdud kyi mgon po nag po seṅge'i gdong*/ gshin rje'i mgon po dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ srin po'i mgon po gza' bdud dug gi spu gri/ lto 'phye'i mgon po klu bdud nā ga rak+ṣa/ btsan gyi mgon po sgrol ging chen po beg rtse/ gnod sbyin gyi mgon po zhang 'on nag po khrag ral can/ ging gi mgon po rgyal po chen po bhe ha ra/ phyogs bcu mgon po rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ btsun mo nang mi snag gi gnyen mngag gzhug dmag gi sde dang bcas pa dam pa chos byed pa'i bka' sdod thams cad la mchod sbyin rgya chen po 'di 'bul lo// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ khyad par dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod cig /sgos rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sngon gyi las 'phral gyi rkyen ngan pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ phas kyi sngags bon mu stegs nag pos phyag rgya sngags ting nge 'dzin ci dang ci byad du stems pa/ sa la mnan pa/ chu la gtad pa/ me la bsreg pa/ rlung la bskor ba la sogs pa thams cad byed pa po kho rang la gshed du phob cig /snang srid kyi lha 'dre za ba'i kha gtad pa/ gnod pa'i dbal 'dzugs pa/ mtho rgyan gzhi btings pa/ sho'i rde'u spung ba/ byad kyi khram kha 'debs pa thams cad dgra la sgyur cig /zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ drag po'i las thams cad la dbang dang ldan pa/ grub pa brgyad dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dngos grub kyi mchog sbyin par mdzad du gsol/ bsdu na/ dpal mgon lcam dral bka' sdod tshogs bcas la// mchod gtor 'di 'bul spyi dang bye brag gi// bstan pa cher rgyas bdag cag 'gal rkyen sol// zhi sogs las dang dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol//

ces 'dod don gsol/ hūṃ| bde gshegs thugs rje sku sprul pa// sems can rnams la mgon skyabs mdzad// 'og min gnas na bzhugs pa la// rab tu btud de phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das kyi skur ston pa// 'dren pa 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gtso// drag po ma rung 'dul mdzad pa// mahā kā lir phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten la gnas gdug pa 'dul// dur khrod ma mo rnams kyi gtso// lha chen drag po'i skur ston pa// 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi gsol kha bsdus pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dh+yaḥsarba ngharmaḥswabhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dur khrod kyi// sa gzhi keṃ rus baṃ ro gsar rnying dang*// skam rlon thod pa khrag zhag zhun sbyar ba'i// gzhal yas 'jigs rung gru gsum yangs pa'i nang*// drag po'i 'brug glog gnam lcags me'i ser ba// 'bebs byed sprin nag bskal me 'khrugs pa'i dbus// pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ yig 'phro 'du las// dpal ldan las byed mgon po bya rog gdong*// mthing nag sbom thung gnam lcags mchu sder can// rdo rje'i gshog gdeng phyag gnyis gri gug dang*// thod khrag 'dzin cing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dor stabs drag po yis// dgra bgegs bdud dpung brdzis pa'i g.yon ngos na// dmar mo 'bar gdong tsaṇ+ḍi ka dang ni// phyogs mtshams rang 'dra'i tshe bdag srog bdag dang*// 'chi bdag la sogs byar gdong stong phrag dang*// sha za 'bum sde ma mo bye ba'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro sde brgyad yang 'khor dpag med bcas// kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan gyur// hūṃ| khrag 'thung dbyings kyi rol gar gdug pa'i gshed// ma lus dregs gtso dpal ldan las kyi mgon// 'khor bcas bsil ba'i tshal nas myur bar ni// 'bod pa'i dbyangs brdas bskul lo gshegs su gsol// oṃ mahā kā la su tri ya ma du dzaḥ

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ a bhi ṣāñtsa tu maṃ/ hūṃ| rnam dag lta ba'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i 'jing*// 'khrul med sgom pa'i me tog spyod pa'i spos// ting 'dzin sgron me sdom pa'i dri chab dang*// 'bras bu'i zhal zas rdzogs pa'i rol mo 'bul// oṃ las khyab gdal chos dbyings thod pa'i klong*// aḥlas 'gag med rang gdangs gtor ma'i tshogs// hūṃ las sna tshogs dkar dmar 'phro 'du can// ha ho hrīḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la ya shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e ṣa a paṣi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tī dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ sa twa na/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūṃ phaṭa hūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba ngharmā ṇāṃ a da nut+pan+na tota oṃ ā:hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ spro na 'dod gsol rgyas pa dang/ bsdu na/ las mgon bya rog gdong can 'khor bcas la// bstan dgra'i sha khrag rus gtor 'di 'bul lo// bstan dang de 'dzin spyi bye bdag cag gi// phyi nang gsang ba'i rkyen ngan myur bzlog mdzod// ces brjod/ hūṃ| thod pa'i skyogs kyi khrag 'thung rdo rje'i gdangs// srid pa'i gnyen du bla med zla ba'i cha// mthing nag me 'od 'ja' tshon 'khrugs pa'i rdzu// sna tshogs rang dga'i ngo na kun tu snang*// de phyir srid zhi'i 'phro 'du rang rig tu// shes pas bstod bral khyod la bstod bgyid na// skye 'jig sgyu ma'i g.yul ngo bcom pa dang*// ye shes snang ba phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod// nyon mongs rang rig klong du zhi ba dang*// ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i rtsal snang dbang sdud cing*// yid srub drag po'i 'phrul 'khor tshar gcod pa'i// 'phrin las khyod la re'o myur sgrub mdzod//

ces bstod cing 'dod don gsol// //༈ dpal ye shes kyi lha mo dud sol ma'i gsol kha bsdus pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e yaṃ waṃ raṃ laṃ// suṃ bh+rūṃ zhu bas chos 'byung 'byung bzhi'i dal// ri rab rwa gur rin chen gzhal med khang*// mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i nang du thod pa'i mkhar// gru gsum me rlung 'khrugs pa'i khrag mtsho'i dbus// mthing nag hūṃ las bcom ldan dud sol ma// nag po'i sprin 'dra khro gtum sbeg pa'i gzugs// mche gtsigs ljags 'dril mi ro rengs pa gsol// dmar ba'i spyan gsum bzlog gzigs zur phud can// lan bu g.yon 'khyil thod pa sbrul gyis brgyan// snyan gong dar nag ut+pal ro nye dang*// sbrul dang seṅge'i rna rgyan glang lpags gsol// phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri thod khrag g.yon// shak+ti tri shu bzung zhing phyag rgya drug /khrag zhag lha min mgo yi do shal can// ba lang ko rlon re ldes smad dkris nas// klu dbang ska rags btsan 'khyil lcags sgrog 'chang*// gwa dmar bong bu'i steng du 'gying zhing sgeg /zur gsum gcer bu ral can snying khrag 'dzin// phyi snam nang phyogs dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi// gri thod 'dzin ma bdun yang bong bur zhon// phyogs bzhir seṅge stag spyang phag dang mtshams// bya rgod skyung ka dur bya byar gdong ma// dre'u bcibs shing gri thod 'dzin dang sgor// kaṃ ka'i gdong can mda' gzhu spu gri sbrul// nad rkyal g.yon pa thod khrag stag spyang spre'u// drel zhon khor yug ma mo 'bum gyi sde// dur khrod chas brgyan oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan/ /hūṃ| sum cu rtsa bdun gnas kyi pho nya mo'/ི/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug rigs ldan dud sol ma// dad dang gdung bas spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs la// drag shul chen pos dgra bgegs 'joms par mdzod// dṛṣ+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/

hūṃ| smin byed dbang gi chu bo'i ar+ghaṃ sbreng*// dam tshig me tog bskyed rim spos kyis dud// rdzogs pa'i mar me spyod pa'i dri chab dang*// 'bras bu'i zhal zas mchog gis mchod par bgyi// ha las thod pa'i gtor ma gser zhun ltar// hoḥlas dri bzang kun gyi 'byung khungs dang*// hrīḥlas ro bcud lha rdzas las 'das pa'i// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li mahā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ.i daṃ ba ling+ta gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ spro na 'dod gsol rgyas pa dang*/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan dud sol lha mo 'khor bcas la// 'dod yod lnga ldan gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ hūṃ| nghū yig gis brjod bdag nyid thabs kyi lhas// shes rab yum la rjes su chags bzhin pas// bsnyen pa'i tshul shes zhi sogs gang 'dod der// mod la brjod 'di 'ol phyir mi spobs mthu// maṃ yig nā ḍir nyi ma'i sde 'chings pas// nang gi lha mo khyod mnyes nyams brgya'i gar// nā da'i dbyangs sbyar khams gsum du bsgyur tshe// phung khams 'ja' tshon ston pa'ang sgyu ma'i zol// gā yig nyi zla sbyar ba sgra gcan khar// zos dus gsang ba'i ma mo khyod zhabs dran// sgo gsum nghū ti'i dbyings su thim gyur pa'i// mngon par byang chub yud kyis de la shar// ṛ yig sgyu ma'i khams bzhi'i lha mo'i glus// stong bzhi mtha' las sad pa'i ye shes lus// slad nas yang dag mtha' dang nam gzhar yang*// mi phyed dad pas dngos grub sbyin khyod kyis// bshad pa pad+mo'i 'byung gnas 'di nyid du// mkhas pa ngang pa'i ded dpon kun 'dus nas// pad dkar bzhad pa'i dri bsung gis sim pa'i// dam chos mgrin rnga rdung bas rtag 'gengs mdzod//

ces bstod cing 'dod don gsol/ dge bsnyen gsol kha bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ| mtho ba srid pa'i yas steng gi// rtsub 'gyur tshal du ru mtshon can// dkar po lha yi dbang phyug gi// dmag dpon chen po gshegs su gsol// hūṃ| dma' ba sa 'og rim pa dgu'i// grong khyer mchog na srog bdag dmar// chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje yi// las mkhan chen po gshegs su gsol// hūṃ| bar gyi bdud yul kha rag gling*// gdong dmar yul nas ab bse rgyal// zhang zhung bon gyi skyong ba che// dgra'i rgyal po gshegs su gsol// hūṃ| lhag par mon khams thim phu yi// bde chen gnas nas btsan rgod gyad// rig 'dzin bla ma'i bka' nyan mchog /jag pa me len gshegs su gsol// hūṃ| bsad pa'i dmar chol lbu gsar can// dgra bo'i snying rtsa nas 'bab dang*// sna tshogs 'bru yi dza gad ni// gser kha g.yu khas brgyan te 'bul// hūṃ| dgra mgo bregs pa'i 'phreng bas gtibs// sha dri gsar pa'i na bun 'thul// rgyal ba'i ru mtshon snang ba sbar// dpa' bo'i 'brug sgra ldir ba 'bul// hūṃ| yid gar 'ong ba sgrub pa'i rgyan// sdang ba'i dgra bo 'joms pa'i chas// mnabs 'os khyim gyi mnangs chen nor// phyugs kyi 'gro ba kun kyang 'bul// hūṃ| rta dmar glang dmar ra dag gi// sha ni ngar bcas ba ling+ta// snying dang nang khrol sna tshogs kyis// rgya mtsho chen po byas pa 'bul// hūṃ| gdug pa khyod kyi gzugs kyi byin// ma rung jag pa'i tsha ngad kyis// bar chad bgegs kyi phye mar leb// thams cad gzhob kyang med par sreg /hūṃ| gzir ba'i spyan gyis ma non bgegs// khros pa'i zhal gyi mche ba'i rtser// mi len dam tshig nyams pa'i srog /'jig rten khams na cang med do// hūṃ| rdo rje'i rmog zhu khrab chen phub// mdung dmar zhag bzung mdo drug chas// zhud can rtar zhon dpa' skyen gdong*// sus kyang tshugs par mi nus so// hūṃ|

srin bya khus 'debs phag khyi ngar// btsan dmag co sgras khol ba rnams// me ru 'bar zhing rlung dud 'tshubs// dgra bo'i srog la dug tu gyur// hūṃ| srid gsum 'joms pa'i jag pa ni// zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba rnams// dgra bo'i srog rtsa len la song*// srog dang dbugs la rngam zas gyis// hūṃ| mi sdug gzugs dgu'i sgyu 'phrul jag /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du sgyur// mi nyan ngag gi dmod pa'i me// len mkhan dgra 'di yin pas sgyur// hūṃ| lha srin dregs pa'i jag dpon khyod// thub pa'i lha 'dre gar yang med// mi bo zas skal yin pa'i phyir// dgra bo me 'dra srog len mdzod// hūṃ| jag dmar ral dgu brdabs nas khyod rbod do// dam bskul me dpung spar nas khyod rbod do// len rtsa'i rtsa ba bshad nas khyod rbod do// dgra bo tshar gcod las 'di myur du sgrubs// dam can jag pa me len zhes// grub pa'i bka' nyan de mchod pa'i// cho ga hūṃ sgra bcu drug pa// pad+ma dkar po bdag gis sbyar// //༈ sgo mo lung pa'i gsol kha bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ| rdo rje lhun po'i zom chen por// gza' rgod chen po'i mtshan yang 'dzin// phyag brnyan lha min tshogs chen pos// bskor nas 'dir gshegs ki kang khyod// hūṃ| lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug na// 'chi bdud nag po'i mtshan yang 'dzin// bka' nyan dmyal srung gtum po'i sdes// bskor nas 'dir gshegs las gshin khyod// hūṃ| sprul pa'i zhing gi lho phyogs su// sgo bdud chen po'i mtshan yang 'dzin// las mdzad sde brgyad bshan pa'i tshogs// bskor nas 'dir gshegs gnas srung khyod// hūṃ| dpa' bo'i chang phud rgya mtshor bskyil// dmar chol khrag sna'i ar+ghaṃ sbreng*// mthun rdzas bshos bu ri dbang rtser// dkar dmar zla nyis mdzes pa 'bul// hūṃ| dmigs pa'i dgra bo dam nyams kyi// srog dang dbugs dang bla dang tshe// sha khrag rus pa'i ba ling+ta// dmar gyi ngad dri chil bas mchod// hūṃ|

nag po'i ngar la bdud kyi mkhar// dgyes dgu yas dang thag las grub// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod ngo mar// byin gyis brlabs pas thugs dam bskang*// hūṃ| mthong ba'i dug rlangs sprin nag gis// mun par 'thibs gzugs lta byed glog /stong phrag g.yo la khrag gis char// ci yang 'bebs la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ| za bar byed pa'i kha bo che// mtshon cha'i ngar kun 'dril ba'i sos// dgra srog gtub pa'i rak+ta'i rgyun// ma baṃ 'gram par 'dzag la bstod// hūṃ| rgyal ba'i dam tshig chang 'thungs pas// myos pa'i gad rgyangs mi zad pa// rnam par rol pa brgya phrag gis// ma rungs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// sger gsol rnams la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ mgon po lcam dral gyi gsol kha'i rjes su spungs gtor la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ gtor rdzas rnams mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ phyi ltar rin po che las grub pa'i gtor snod srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i nang du/ gtor rdzas rnams ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ rnam pa 'dod yon gyi sprin phung 'phro ba/ nang ltar ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod du/ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa srog dbugs bla tshe khar rje dbang thang rlung rta la sogs 'dus pa'i phung po/ gsang ba shes rab bha ga'i snod du/ thabs mchog ling gas gtams pa'i bde stong dga' bzhi ro bcud 'pho med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhū?ṃ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs byas te/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i snying ga'i 'od kyis bskul bas/ lcang lo can sogs rang rang so so'i gnas nas rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras/ lha sman tshe ring mched lnga/ sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron/ las gshin cig car dmar po/ gza' rgod dug gi spu gri/ gter bdag smyon kha'i klu btsan/ dkor bdag rgyal chen sku lnga/

gangs bzang mi sngon rta sngon/ dge bsnyen jag pa me len/ dam can sgo mo lung pa/ jo bo shing rta'i kha lo/ gnam 'brug phu mda'i gzhi bdag /gdan sa 'di nyid du gnyug mar gnas pa che ge mo la sogs bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho thams cad skad cig gis byon nas dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu bzhugs pa'i ljags 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ rnam sras la/ oṃ bai shra wā ṇā ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tshe ring mar/ maṃ laṃ aṃ tsaṃ taṃ pañtsa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra= / g.yu sgron mar/ oṃ badz+ra la la li li sa pa ri wā ra= / cig car la/ yu ga pad+mo hi ta sa pa ri wā ra= / drang srong la/ hrī shaka ru raṃ na ga li haṃ shaṃ tri dzaḥdzaḥshaka rak+ṣa ka ra hūṃ ba ling+ta khā hi/ na ga li haṃ shaṃ tri dzaḥdzaḥb ling+ta khā hi ra hu la pak+ṣi me ke ru ru te dz+wa la te+i swāhā ba ling+ta khā hi/ smyon kha la/ oṃ nag po ti pa rā dza nā ga rak+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra=/ rgyal po la/ ngharma pā la mahā rā dza bhe ha ra = / gdan sa pa la/ yak+ṣa pur ṇa bha dra = /ma nu khā sho ni la= / dge bsnyen la/ oṃ sarba suṃ tri ri tri na na kha re bh+ruṃ= / sgo mo la/ mu khī ma ra kriṣ+ṇā= / gnam 'brug phu mda' par/ a d+ya nu kam+pa= /lag mi nī gā= /a mu khe de shas+tha ba= / gzhi bdag spyi 'gro la/ oṃ a ka ro= / rnams lan gsum res 'bul/ 'dod gsol ni/ rgyal bstan sgrub brgyud snying po dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bstan la sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs choms/ dam sri rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul zlog /'jig rten dus kyi rgud pa sel/

sems can yongs kyi phan bde spel/ khyad par du'ang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gnas skabs su nad gdon chag che nyam nga lo keg zla gshed la sogs 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa mtha' dag las srung zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang longs spyod snyan grags mnga' thang sogs mthun pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ tshe gang dben pa'i ri sul du sgrub pa snying por len pa'i rgyu can nyams rtogs kyi gshog rtsal nang nas rdzogs te/ nam zhig rnam smin lus kyi sgong rgya ral ma thag tu mkha' spyod bde ba chen po'i zhing du dbugs 'byin zhing*/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la sbyor ba'i stongs grogs dang 'phrin las rgya chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces dang*/ spro na/ kyai| sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phangs bstod// dge 'dun sde skyong rnal 'byor tshe srog srings// snyan pa'i dar 'phyar grags pa'i dung 'bud la// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas// mig la ya mtshan ltad mos dga' ba dang*// rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing*// dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral mdzod// zas skom 'byor pa ro yis tshim byed cing*// yid la rnam par bkra ba'i shes rab rgyas// lus la reg 'jam bde bas nam yang khyab// zag med bde bas nam yang ngoms par mdzod// khyod gsol khyod bsten khyod bsgrubs khyod rbad na// mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che ba yis// gzhi la bkra shis longs spyod phun sum tshogs// byes su lam 'phrang chu las sgrol 'don mdzod// 'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs// mdor na bsam don ma lus 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan pa yis// bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod// gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar mdzad pa yi// chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis// bdag cag bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod//

bshags pa ni/ oṃ| ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni// zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang*// thugs rje nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol// brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa'i lha// zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis// mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun// 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pa// gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che// chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing*// rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa'i// mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud// āḥ kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la// phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings// 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams// gsang chen rab dgyes gzugs can bdag nyid ma// mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mo 'khyil ba las// gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing*// ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku// cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha// 'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang*// byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu// gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi// ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dang*// ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma// phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// dbang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol// hūṃ|

thugs rje gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin bdag cag gis// 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de// bla med go 'phang bgrod par bya ba'i phyir// bstan pa rgya mtsho'i so so'i 'dul khrims dang*// sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' dka' dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer// spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams// snga phyir mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal// yun du mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid cing*// don la gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang*// gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis// klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*// shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te// sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs// tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis na// ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'das gyur te// rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'phrad par mi bya zhes// bka' las byung zhing de ltar ma lcogs te// gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye bsal dka' ba dang*// mngon shes med pas skyon can ma rtogs te// nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang*// nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang*// nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa'i skyon la sogs// nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gis// nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal// tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams// rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// byams pa'i thugs brtses bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod de// dmigs med btang snyoms ngang la bzhugs nas kyang*// gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol// don dam dmigs med spros las 'das pas na// rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur zhing*// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis ni// nongs par mchis na rab gnongs bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa

sogs yig brgya brjod/ bdag gzhan lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum// ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dang ni// gang yang yid kyi rnam gsum po// mi dge bcu po so sor bshags// mtshams med lnga po bdag gzhan sdig pa rnams// gang gi mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag/ de yi ltung ba bshags pa 'di brjod pas// myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar shog / de nas tshogs rdzas rnams bshams la bdud rtsi bran te/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ zhes lan gcig gis sbyangs zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ kyai| dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rje// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i che mchog he ru*// 'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sku mchog 'gyur med bud+dha thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i bud+dha he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gsung mchog 'gag med pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i pad+ma he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// thugs mchog dri med badz+ra thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i badz+ra he ru ka

/'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// yon tan kun rdzogs rat+na thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i rin chen he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'phrin las thogs med karma thod 'phreng rtsal// 'od gsal lhun grub skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku// mnyam pa med pa'i karma he ru ka /'gro mgon bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che// thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku// tshogs rdzas 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

de nas phud gsum rim par 'bul ba ni/ dang por phud kyis mi mchod du// rig 'dzin lha tshogs phud la mnyes// des na phud kyi mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir bsam nas 'bul// bar du tshogs kyis mi mchod du// ma dang mkha' 'gro tshogs la mnyes// des na tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// bshags shing skong ba'i rten du 'bul// tshogs mtha' ma'i 'dod yon rang la bsdus nas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu dmigs te/ mtha' mar bsgral bas mi mchod du// chos skyong srung ma baṃ la mnyes// des na tshogs kyi mtha' ma 'di// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rdzas su 'bul// zhes rim par phul/ tshogs bsdus gsog par spro na/ oṃ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// āḥthod dkar dpral ba rang la bstan// hūṃ sha lnga ye shes bdud rtsi lnga// hrīḥtshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūṃ la na gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ drag dmar gyi skabs su dkar brgyud bla ma'i tshab tu rig 'dzin bla ma ( zhes bsgyur ) thams cad la// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho la// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// chos bdag gnas bdag thams cad la// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// mched dang lcam dral thams cad la// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang*// nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig /sdig sgrib thams cad dag gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /mngon gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi/ tshogs 'bum lta bu gsog skabs shin tu bsdus pa ni/

rig 'dzin bla ma thams cad dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni dharma pā la gha ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi/ zhes ci nus gsog /de nas bshags pa ni/ kyai| mahā kā la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor sgor zhugs nas// bka' yi dam tshig gnyan po bsrung rgyu la// bka' ltar ma gyur gzhung bzhin rngo ma thogs// bsnyen sgrub dus 'das phud dang gtor ma chag /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun// rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la bshags// oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs brjod/ dam can bskang ba bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ| lha mi 'dod yon ma lus tshogs pa'i sprin// so so'i thugs la dgyes dgu'i char 'bebs pa// nam mkha'i khams rnams kun nas khyab pa 'dis// dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// g.yag lug rta khyi gcan gzan gtum po'i tshogs// bya nag rten gtor g.yang gzhi dpa' bo'i snying*// srog gi 'khor lo'i bltems sogs rang rang gi// rten rdzas rgya cher spel bas thugs dam bskang*// sku brnyan rnga dang cang te'u sil snyan dung*// bong bu gwa dmar nal bu'i rgyal mtshan snying*// mdongs mtha' can gyi gar dang 'dod yon lnga// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng bas thugs dam bskang*// rin chen go cha rno ba'i dgra cha dang*// 'phyar ba'i dar dang bsra ba'i lag cha dang*// blta bas mi ngoms spyan gzigs dkor cha'i dbyig /gaṅga'i klung rdul grangs chas thugs dam bskang*// dri ro bcud mdangs phud kyi bza' btung ni// srid na ci mchis de snyed spungs pa gang*// sngags rgyas dam tshig rdzas su legs bsnyen pa'i// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*// dgyes bzhin 'khor bas 'gal rkyen sel ba dang*// gnad du bskul ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i rgyu/

mchod dang nye bar bsgrub pa'i sgom bzlas sogs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas yongs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ lcam dral khyed dang dam can ma lus par// mchog tu gdung shugs ldan kyang mi mkhas pas// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i dam tshig las nyams pa// do nub bskang ngo bshags so thugs dam can// de ltar bskang zhing bshags nas 'dod pa'i don// ma lus sgrub cing lhag par bdag cag la// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pas las brtsams pa// gang mchis dgra bgegs nyid la bzlog par mdzod// rtsa ltung bshags pa ni/ rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū lā pa ti/ bod skad du/ rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// kun nas dwang bas bla ma yi// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni// rgyud las gsungs pa bshad par bya// gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsungs// de bas de la brnyas pa ni// rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad// dang po phog pa mthol lo bshags// bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni// ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad// gnyis pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// rdo rje spun la khros pa ni// nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin// gsum pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// sems can rnams la byams pa spong*// bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs// bzhi pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// de spong ba ni lnga pa yin// lnga pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'// chos la smod pa drug pa yin// drug pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba sgrog pa bdun pa yin// bdun pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// phung po sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin// brgyad pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la// som nyi za ba dgu pa yin// dgu pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa| |byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod// bcu pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la// der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa// bcu gcig phog pa mthol lo bshags// sems can dad dang ldan pa yi// sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa// bcu gnyis phog pa mthol lo bshags// dam tshig las ni ji bzhin rnyed// mi brten pa de bcu gsum pa// bcu gsum phog pa mthol lo bshags// bud med shes rab rang bzhin la// smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa// bcu bzhi phog pa mthol lo bshags// rab tu bde ba 'phrog par byed// dam tshig dad dang mi ldan pa'i// rig ma bsten par dga' ba ni// yan lag nyes pa dang po yin// dang po phog pa mthol lo bshags// tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa ni// yan lag nyes pa gnyis pa yin// gnyis pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// ma gsungs pa yi rig ma la// sngags pas bdud rtsi 'thob byed pa// yan lag nyes pa gsum pa yin// gsum pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// gsang chos yan lag shes gyur kyang*//gzhan la mi ston shes rab ngan// yan lag nyes pa bzhi pa yin// bzhi pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// dad pas sems can chos kyi rgyu// gzhan gyi gtam byed byang chub sems// yan lag nyes pa lnga pa yin// lnga pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// nyan thos nang du zhag bdun 'das// yan lag nyes pa drug pa yin// drug pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// rnal 'byor ye shes mi shes pa// nga ni sngags pa yin zer ba// yan lag nyes pa bdun pa yin

/bdun pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// snod min sems can thams cad la// phyi yi chos bshad yin pa la// gsang ba'i don rnams 'chad pa ni// yan lag nyes pa brgyad pa yin// brgyad pa phog pa mthol lo bshags// oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs brjod/ rtsa ltung bshags pa bton nas thams cad tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsdus la kha phru btab ste/ bh+rūṃ pheṃ/ snod thod pa dang bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por zhu bar bsam/ lhag ma'i bshal chus mi mchod du// ma sring ma mo lhag la dgyes// kha phrus bran pa'i mchod pa 'di// mthun pa'i rdzas su dngos nas 'bul// oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta bhak+ṣa bh+ya swāhā/ zhes phyi rol du dor/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo mchod pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog/ nyes ltung dri mas ma gos shing*// rlabs chen spyod pa rdzogs pa dang*// he ru ka dang mnyam pa yi// go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par shog/ pha ma sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stong par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig / ces smon lam btab bo// mgon po'i gnyer gsol ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol/ dpal rdo rje mgon po nag po 'jigs byed chen po he ru ka dang rang bzhin chos nyid du gcig pa/ ngo bo ye shes su mtshungs pa/ mtshan nyid 'phrin las thogs med du mnyam pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo/ snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi yang rje/ zhing skyong drag po las gnyan gyi ded dpon/ mi pham rdo rje gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor bu bzhin du skyong ba/ dam can sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod nyul ba/ zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la myur ba bstan pa srung ba la rtsal 'byin pa/

mthu dang stobs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje drag rtsal can bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pas btsugs pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'di la bzhugs la| rnal 'byor pa bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub/ bde ba chen po'i zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam gyi bar chad bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i skyel ma mdzod cig /yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bsun ma dang phrad par mdzod cig /de ltar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam la mi 'jug cing*/ thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing*/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi gnas nas/ ci bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med par thob nas/ 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur par mdzad du gsol/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'phrin las kyi bya ba la bdag gis gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ lha mo'i gnyer gsol ni/ bh+yoḥ mkha' 'gro ma nag mo dud pa'i sol ba ma/ ma ltar mnyes gshin/ rgya mtsho ltar dkyel che/ ri bo ltar lhun chags/ nyi zla ltar 'od gsal/ nor bu ltar re ba skong ba/ ci bgyi'i dbang phyug ma 'khor dang bcas pa la rnal 'byor pa bdag gis gtad gnyer du bya ba'i 'os/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis/ bka' dang bstan pa/ chos dang dam tshig /tshe dang bsod nams/ nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa/ bskul zhing bcol ba'i las/ slob ma dang 'khor/ sbyin pa dang 'bangs/ dkor dang longs spyod/ mnga' ris dang dbang phyug /sde dang srid/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang*/ dgon gnas dang yul 'khor du bcas pa thams cad gtad kyi/ mthun zhing dgyes pa'i rten rdzas dam tshig gi gzugs su gyur pa 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs te/ gnas lus longs spyod mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa/

las bcol zhing gtad pa 'di mtha' dag gi gnyer kha gyis la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag las srungs/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs/ gong nas gong du spel/ snying la gces pa dang brnag pa ma dor bas byang chub kyi bar du bstan pa skyongs la yid bzhin du 'dod pa 'jo ba byos shig /oṃ ye dharma dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pā ri wā ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shap+ta bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ| chos kyi dbyings nas bdud sder khros pa'i gzugs// mahā kā la yab yum sras dang 'khor// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas dkyil 'khor gyi// lha tshogs kun la dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas rjes chog ni/ kyai| lha rdzas me tog kun gyis nam mkha' bkab// dri zhim bdug spos bsregs pas sa gzhi bkang*// snang gsal 'od gsal phyogs bcu'i mthar 'brel ba// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// sim skyed bdud rtsi byugs pa'i chu 'dzin g.yos// bda' dgu'i zhal zas thams cad char du babs// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog pa rnams// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// mdzes ma bro brdung snyan pa'i glu blangs mthar// dri zhim ngad 'gyed ma mchu'i sbrang sbyin nas// reg mtha' bde ba bha gas ston pa rnams// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// myos byed dpa' bo'i dam rdzas phud chen 'thor// snang srid ma mo'i mchod rdzas rak+ta sbreng*// thun mong mnyes pa'i ba liṃ cher bshams pa// rig 'dzin chen po khyod la mchod pa 'bul// bstod pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas sku yi 'phro 'du las// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i khro rgyal drag po rtsal// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do lus la byin gyis rlobs// snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi 'phro 'du las// gsang ba 'dus pa'i sngags rgod dmod pa'i mtshon// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do ngag la byin gyis rlobs// snang ba mtha' yas thugs kyi 'phro 'du las// sor rtog ye shes rdzogs pa chen po'i klong*// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las pa// khyod la bstod do yid la byin gyis rlobs//

zhes bstod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*// cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*// bdag gis rjed ngas ci bgyid pa// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// ces bzod par gsol/ sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rten la dmigs te/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan gcig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams sbyin par mdzad du gsol// supra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pas brtan bzhugs bya/ skye med chos kyi dbyings nyid las// 'gag med rdo rja srin po shar// 'gag pa nyid na 'gag pa med// spros bral chos sku'i klong du thim// zhes bdag bskyed bsdu ldang byas grub pa dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rig 'dzin chen po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /khyod la mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su// nad gdon dbul 'phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang*// chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// zangs dpal smon lam ni/ mkha' glong rnam dag 'og min rdo rje'i dbyings// rgyal ba'i zhing mchog rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i gar// ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi dbang po brtsegs pa'i tog /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog /sangs rgyas 'od snang mtha' yas ye shes kyi// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i drwa bas mngon sum du// mdzes dgur brgyan pa pad+ma'i gzhal yas khang*// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog /rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal// gang 'dul 'phrin las 'khor lo'i gzi byin gyis// kun dga' brgyan pa'i pho brang pad+ma 'od// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog

/nor bu'i ba gam brtsegs pa'i ri dbang rtser// pad+ma rā ga'i khang brtsegs nor bu'i tog /mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung phyogs kyi bla bres pa// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog /a kar+gho shrir+ṣa dang p+la k+ṣa'i// nags tshal stugs por 'khrigs pa'i drwa mig nas// dbang po'i shing bal g.yo ba'i lang tsho can// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog /khams gsum dug gsum sna tshogs 'dus pa'i srog /spyod la dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i man+ḍa lar// mkha' spyod longs spyod 'dus pa'i 'khor lo can// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog /dpa' bo rig 'dzin tshogs pa'i gral dbus na// pad+ma rgyal po seṅge'i sgra sgrog pas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' brjid can// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog /tsan dan dri zhim gyis bgos 'chi med lha'i// me tog char zim 'bab pa'i do ra na// ḍāk+ki'i gar mkhan rtse ba'i rgyang glu can// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog/ mtshungs med blo ldan thugs rje'i rang bzhin dang*// lhan cig mngon par mtho ba lhun po'i dpal// nyi ma'i rgyan gyur nyi 'od kyis mdzes pa// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo skye bar shog /'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+mas rjes 'dzin cing*// mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing mchog pad+ma 'od// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /

gung thang la thog tu mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gu ru'i zhabs spyi bor blang ste smon lam btab pa/ mahā gu ru'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag cag tshe rabs thams cad du// zhing khams dag pa'i pho brang du// bla ma 'bral med bsten par shog /mos gus ltems brkyang med pa yis// mnyes pa'i zhabs tog sgrub pa dang*// dgongs pa zab mo thugs kyi bcud// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i lung thob shog /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis// lus ngag yid gsum smin pa dang*// zab mo'i bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis la// dbang gi sgrub pa thob par shog /log lta bdud kyi tshogs rnams dang*// nad gdon rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa yis// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog / dur khrod ri khrod gangs khrod sogs// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas nyid du// ting 'dzin zab mo'i dgongs spyod la// rtag tu sgrub pa byed par shog /sgrub pa byed pa'i 'bras bu yis// 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang*// lha srin bran du 'khol nas kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar shog /ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos rnams// rtsol med rgyud la 'char ba dang*// mkhyen pa mchog la mnga' brnyes shing*// rtogs pa mchog dang ldan par shog /byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel gyis// skye 'gro thams cad dbang 'dus nas// thogs med yid bzhin nor bu'i gter// 'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba'i mthus// brgyud 'dzin chos don rgyas pa dang*// 'gro kun bde la 'khod nas kyang*// zhing khams thams cad dag par shog /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// gdul bya so so'i blo yul du// gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku// dpag tu med par 'byung bar shog /mdor na 'khor 'das ma lus kun// gu ru nyid dang dbyer med cing*// sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa yis// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog

/sems can gsol ba 'debs par shog /bla mas byin gyis rlobs par shog /yi dam dngos grub ster bar shog /mkha' 'gros lung bstan byed par shog /chos skyong bar chad sel bar shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis// 'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs nas// srid mtshor slar yar mi gnas shing*// phyam gcig sangs rgyas myur thob shog /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod// bla med mchog gi theg pa 'di// ji ltar mkha' la nyi shar ltar// rgyal khams yongs la dar rgyas shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag tu gyur nas bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa yi/ skyes bu stobs ldan du gyur cig /mkhyen brtse nus gsum mthar phyin nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig /rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal chen po las sgrol nus pa'i ded dpon chen por skye bar gyur cig /de kho na bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig / bdag pad+ma gling pas lho brag sman mdo'i brag seṅge'i gdong pa can nas gdan drangs pa'o// rje btsun khyed dang thugs rje mnyam par shog /rgyal sras khyed dang gdul bya mnyam par shog /thod 'phreng rtsal dang 'phrin las mnyam par shog/ tshe dpag med dang sku tshe mnyam par shog /'jam dpal dbyangs dang mkhyen rab mnyam par shog /spyan ras gzigs dang 'gro don mnyam par shog/ gsang ba'i bdag dang mthu stobs mnyam par shog /longs spyod rdzogs dang mtshan dpe mnyam par shog /kun tu bzang dang zhing khams mnyam par shog /nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// mi gtsang lus 'di'i sgyu ma bor ma thag

/bde ba can du rdzus te skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab rdzogs te// sprul pa re re bdag gis bkye nas kyang*// thams cad 'dren pa'i ded dpon bdag gyur cig /bdag gzhan gnyis med chos sku mthar phyin nas// ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings su grol bar shog / smon lam 'di rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin grags pa'i gsung yin no// bsngo ba dang smon lam yongs su grub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ngha re ngha re bhan ngha re bhan ngha re swāhā/ dge ba stobs che bar gyur cig /sdig pa 'dag skyen par gyur cig /smon lam mthu btsan par gyur cig /dza ya dza ya sid+dhi sid+dhi pha la pha la bkra shis par gyur cig /de ltar grub pa yang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis ji ltar smon pa de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /o rgyan pad+ma'i khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe tshad dang zhing khams sogs// khyod kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// 'di 'dra kho na bdag sogs skye bar shog / 'gro la phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig pu// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rin po che// phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// 'gro kun thabs mkhas de yis grol gyur cig /yul ljongs spyi dang bye brag 'brug yul 'dir// mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i ming yang mi grags shing*// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*// dge 'dun sde rnams dar zhing rgyas par shog /sa skyong mi dbang chab srid brtan pa dang*// 'bangs rnams bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog /'di yi dge bas bstan pa rgyas pa'i gegs// bdud rigs rnams dang de yis yid bskyod pa'i// log par bsgrub pa mtha' dag tshar bcad nas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur bsgreng bar shog

/gnas 'dir dpal 'byor byin rlabs mi nyams shing*// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gdug rtsub zhi ba dang*// bslab gsum rnam dag bstan pa gces 'dzin pa'i// dge 'dun tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa smon lam grub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// las dang glo bur rkyen las gyur pa yi// gdon dang nad dang 'byung po'i 'tshe ba sogs// sems can yid mi bde ba'i nad rnams kun// 'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /ji ltar gshed mas khrid pa'i bsad bya bzhin// skad cig gcig la lus sems 'bral byed pa'i// srog 'phrog nad kyi sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// 'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha nang tshud pa ltar// nad kyi ming tsam thos pas skrag byed pa'i// nyin gcig pa dang rtag pa'i rim sogs kyis// lus can kun la gnod par ma gyur cig /gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// glo bur ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu dang*// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad la sogs pa yis// lus can kun la 'tshe bar ma gyur cig /lus sems bde ba ma lus 'phrog byed pa'i// 'byung bzhi 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// ma lus zhi zhing mdangs stobs ldan gyur nas// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog/ bla ma dkon mchog rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs dang*// las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis// smon lam ji ltar btab pa 'grub gyur cig /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// smon lam rnam dag 'grub par shog /rdo rje 'chang chen til+li nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la sgam po mtha' rtsa pa// sna phu pa dang dpal ldan 'brug pa sogs// dkar brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/rgya gar paṇa chen bod la bka' drin che// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la 'das 'khrungs med*// da lta lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// o rgyan rin po che yi bkra shis shog /chos sku gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nyid las// longs spyod rdzogs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la// mtshan dang dpe byad phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dang*// khyad par o rgyan dben gnas su// dam tshig can rnams bsrung mdzad pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos shing*// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral 'khrul med thugs kyi bkra shis shog/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang*// bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin dpon slob bzhin du mthun pa yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog / grol ba'i nyin nam de'i sang nyin gtang rag gi mjug gang bder smon lam dang bkra shis kyi rim pa ni/ gzhung chog sngar bzhin la dge bsngo'i mjug tu spro na chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis mdzad pa'i dge sbyor 'dun pa'i smon lam 'don/ de tsam mi nus na mthu chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dge sbyor 'dun pa'i smon lam don bsdus 'di ltar/ na mo hā mu dra yaḥ phyogs bcu'i dus gsum bde gshegs sems dpa' nyan thos 'phags pa sras bcas dang*// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i rje btsun dam pa rgyud sde bzhi'i lha ḍāk+ki'i tshogs// chos srung dkar phyogs lhar bcas bdag la brtse bas dgongs shing gzigs nas kyang*// bdag gi smon lam 'di la thugs gtod byin rlabs nus pa smin par mdzod// bdag cag dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs kun tu dad mos brtson 'grus dang*// shes rab spobs pa yon tan che zhing gzugs bzang tshe ring nad med cing*// rigs mtho longs spyod gtong phod snying rje snying rus gnyen po'i go cha che// dbyangs snyan yid 'ong bzang po'i spyod yul nyid la rtag tu gnas par shog

/tshe rabs kun tu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i sku thob drug cu'i gsung*// shes bya la mkhas ye shes thugs ldan bshes gnyen mjal zhing mnyes pa bsgrub// mi mnyes spong zhing bshes gnyen yon tan bdag la 'jug cing rdzogs pa dang*// gzhon nur rab byung tshul khrims dam tshig bslab pa gsum gyi gzhi 'dzin shog /theg chen chos la thos bsam sgom sgrub bar chad med cing yon tan rdzogs// brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin pha rjes bus sobs stong nyid snying rje'i rtsal 'byongs pa'i// rang gzhan don 'grub rtogs pa 'char zhing rkyen ngan lam du long ba dang*// rtogs pa thugs rjes bdag gzhan grol zhing gdul bya dus la bab par shog/ shes rab chen pos bden pa'i don rtogs snying rjes gzhan sdug mi bzod dang*// byin rlabs chen pos gzhan snang bsgyur nus gdams pas gzhan rgyud yon tan 'khod// nyams myong chen pos lam sna 'khrid nus rten 'brel thabs mkhas gzung 'dzin dag /las 'bras shes shing rang 'dod rtsa chod rigs drug la ni sgom thebs shog /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma sangs rgyas 'du shes skye zhing mos gus ldan// byin rlabs 'jug cing skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs dgos med rgyud la skye// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs don gnyis phun tshogs rten 'brel chig chog gnad tshud nas// mnyam bzhag brtan thob zhi gnas bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin 'byongs par shog /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thun mong yon tan dpag med rig pa'i rtsa chod cing*// rnam rtog chos sku 'khor 'das su rtogs skyon yon 'khrul grol lam slong nas// sdug bsngal bder 'char bar chad dngos grub tu shes phyag rgya che la gnas// snang ba dbang 'dus las 'bras 'jog cing 'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog /bdag gzhan kun gyi phan gnod las byas log dang btang snyoms mi 'gro zhing*// rgyu rkyen mtshams sbyor dus gsum las ngan rgyu 'bras thams cad byang ba dang*// dug lnga chos brgyad mi dge'i bsam sbyor skad cig med cing tshogs gnyis rdzogs// sngags kyi snod rung dbang bzhi thob cing ye shes ngos zin 'bras thob shog

/dam tshig sdom ldan bskyed rdzogs brtan thob 'phrin las bzhi 'grub rgyu 'bras shes// rig pa'i 'gro ldog dge sdig 'dor len shes rab snang ba byan tshud cing*// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel la mkhas gzhan snang dbang 'dus smon lam gyi// mthu dang 'bras bu tshe 'di nyid la smin cing bdag gzhan don 'grub shog /tshe rabs kun tu 'gro don 'grub cing pha rol phyin drug bsdu ba bzhi// tshad med bzhi dang las bzhi bslab gsum grub chen brgyad de sgo drug gis// 'bad rtsol med par 'gro ba'i don 'grub skyo dub med cing srog mi blta// bdag la dus gsum dad dang skur 'debs thams cad phan bde sangs rgyas shog /bdag grogs tshangs spyod sangs rgyas yon tan tshe 'di nyid la rab rdzogs nas// bla med byang chub la reg bdag gi tshe rabs la brten dam pa rnams// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las sku tshe zhing khams mdzad pa dang*// rnam 'phrul ye shes mkha' mnyam 'phel nas thugs kyi dgongs pa rab rdzogs shog /dus gsum sems can bde ldan lam zhugs 'jug pa skyon dang bral gyur cig /bdag gi sgo gsum dam pa'i yon tan da lta nyid du rdzogs pa dang*// ba spu'i khung nas sangs rgyas sprul pas mkha' mnyam sems can la re re// snang ma thag tu dad mos dwang bas bdag gi dbang du 'gyur bar shog /dus gsum dag tu bdag cag mthong thos dran reg skad cig ma re la// 'khor 'das rgyud la zag med bde chen gyis tshim nyes bral yon tan rdzogs// dam pa bdag dang thugs yid 'dres shing yid ches rgyun chad med pa dang*// mdor na dam pa'i 'phrin las bdag gis rtsol med du 'grub 'gro 'dul shog /byang chub spyod pas sems can sgo gsum bde gshegs nyid du ngo 'phrod cing*// dgos med zhan log 'khri ba rtsad chod bzlog sgom gnad tshud gnyen por dbang*// 'dod yon bya ba 'khor ba gzhan spyod dag la bdag blo mi 'jug cing*// chos brgyad mgo snyoms ro snyoms gdengs tshud rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar shog

/rnam rtog 'phrin las su 'char re dogs g.yang chod dgag sgrub spang blang bral// rkyen snang chos nyid zhing khams dag snang phyogs med 'char zhing rtogs pa dang*// snang ba bla ma yi dam chos sku sku gsum bde ba sgyu ma dang*// rten 'brel nor bur 'char zhing bzang ngan 'bring gsum spyi bor 'khur bar shog /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs bdag gzhan mnyam nyid du rtogs shing*// bdag gzhan bde sdug spro ba dang bcas brje nus kun la smin khyab cing*// sdug bsngal rang bzhin zag med bder 'char stong nyid don la ro snyoms nas// skyon dag yon tan rtogs pa ting 'dzin nyams myong rgyun chad med skyong shog /tshe 'dir mchog thob byang chub sems 'byongs rang 'dod skad cig mi 'byung zhing*// gzhan don ched du grub chen brgyad thob nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod phun tshogs 'khor rgyas khams gsum dbang 'dus shing*// zhing bcu tshang ba'i gdug pa can rnams drag pos tshar gcod byed par shog /bdag gi sgo gsum gzhan don 'ba' zhig la spyod bdag 'dzin blos thongs shing*// rnam rtog nyon mongs lha 'dre sdug bsngal na tsha 'chi ba lam slong nas// sdug bsngal dang len skyid 'dod spangs shing lha 'dre dbang 'dus bar chad zhi// sems snang gzung 'dzin las dang bya ba ye shes kun la dbang thob shog /bdag 'chi'i dus su gshis ngan gnad gcod sdug bsngal rnam rtog mi 'byung zhing*// dran shes ldan pas dga' spro dang bcas 'chi ba'i 'og rol dag tu yang*// sha rus khrag khu spu pags sen mo lus kyi cha shas rdul res kyang*// 'gro ba'i don 'grub gzhan la phan pa'i 'bras bu nyid du rdzogs par shog /bar do dang po chos skur ngo 'phrod ma zin gnyis pa longs skur dag /mngal sgo ma khegs bsam bzhin skye blangs mngon shes lha mig sngon gnas dran// lam lhag rtsal sbyongs spyan lnga ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul ye shes mchog 'grub cing*// gzhan don rlabs chen ma rig 'khrul 'khor ma stong bar du byed par shog

/dge ba'i rtsa 'dis bdag gzhan sems can theg pa chen po'i sgor 'jug cing*// dbang thob dam ldan bskyed rim brtan thob gtum mo la sogs lam brgyad 'byongs// 'phrin las bzhi yi ting 'dzin 'grub cing mkha' 'gro dbang 'dus mchog thun 'grub// tshe 'di nyid la dge rtsa'i 'bras bu smon lam thams cad rdzogs par shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la sems can bsod nams bde skyid spel// bstan pa mi nyams gnod pa dang bral bslab pa dag la nan tan spyod// dge 'dun tshogs 'phel mthun pa dang bcas rnyed dang bkur sti 'phel ba dang*// rgyal bstan de 'dzin skyes bu'i skyon bral yon tan yun ring gnas par shog /bskal pa grangs med sems can thams cad srid mtha'i bar du 'gro don spyod// pha rol phyin drug byang chub spyod pa rlabs chen zad med spyod pa dang*// 'khor gyi gdul bya tshe dang zhing khams go cha dge rtsa smon lam mtha'// tshad bzung med cing mkha' dbyings shes bya'i dkyil 'khor dag dang mnyam par shog /mdor na rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki chos srung dang*// chos mdzad grub thob dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// da lta nyid du sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las sku tshe zhing*// mdzad pa rnam thar nus mthu rtogs pa'i ye shes 'gro don mnyam gyur cig /

ces dang*/ bde gshegs ston pa'i bstan pa mchog gi mtsho// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrog pa'i sprin 'phreng gis// bshad sgrub char gyis nyin bzhin rnam spel ba// yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig /sdom gsum nyin mo'i 'od dang rtag 'grogs shing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i dri bzang 'dzin pa'i dpyid// bstan 'dzin pad+mo'i gtso bo ci yang gis// yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig /rnyed dang bkur sti'i chu klung rnams 'bab cing*// phan dang bde ba'i rin chen skye ba'i gnas// chos 'khor gsar pa gsar pa'i dpal rgya mtshos// yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byed cing*// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /'gro kun dge rtsa ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po spyod phyir de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig/ bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*/ dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// smon lam rnam dag 'grub par shog/ oṃ bde legs rgya mtsho'i dkon mchog rin chen la// dad pa rgya mtsho'i 'dun pas phyag byas te// skye dgu rgya mtsho'i dpal du gyur pa yis// bkra shis rgya mtsho'i shis pa brjod par bgyi// rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje 'chang chen til+li nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la sgam po mtha' rtsa pa| |sna phu pa dang dpal ldan 'brug pa sogs// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas kun bdag 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog/ de yi rjes bzung grub chen sha wa ri// gnas lnga rig pa'i grub mchog nags kyi mtshan// dpal ldan bla ma rgyal dbang chos kyi rje// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang rin po che// nyer brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/rgya gar paṇa chen bod la bka' drin che// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la 'das 'khrungs med// da lta lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// o rgyan rin po che yi bkra shis shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma 'dab 'dra rgyas pa'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo mtshar shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi bkra shis shog /pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan// sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag /phag mos mgul 'khyud dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor// bde mchog lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dbus kyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis don gyi lha// rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /shar gyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis don gyi lha// rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog

/lho yi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis don gyi lha// rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /nub kyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis don gyi lha// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog/ byang gi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// don yon grub pa bkra shis don gyi lha// don yon grub pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /oṃ yon tan rgyas pa sku mdog gser dang mtshungs// shes rab chen po'i rtags su ral gri bsnams// 'phags pa 'jam dpal bkra shis gang yin pa'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /āḥthugs rje bsil mdzad sku mdog zla nya 'dra// skyon gyis ma gos phyag na pad+ma bsnams// spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis gang yin pa'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /hūṃ 'gyur ba med pa sku mdog mthing nag ste// mthu stobs cher ston phyag na rdo rje bsnams// gsang ba'i bdag po'i bkra shis gang yin pa'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rta mchog sku// nyi ma'i 'od mtshungs nyon mongs bsreg /bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo rta mgrin chen po'i bkra shis shog /chos sku gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nyid las// longs spyod rdzogs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la// mtshan dang dpe byad phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi mkha' 'gro dang*// khyad par o rgyan dben gnas su// dam tshig can rnams bsrung mdzad pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan bsrung phyir// 'jigs byed mi bzad drag po'i lus dang ldan// rngam pa'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi tshar gcod pa'i// mgon po bya rog mtshan gyi bkra shis shog

/sa bcu nyid la gnas pa'i sems dpa' yang*// gzi brjid me ltar 'bar ba'i khro tshul gyis// bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod//ye shes mgon po'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /zab mo rgyud kyi srung ma ma mo ni// zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub// rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i// khrag 'thung dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog /de yi sku gsung thugs sprul pho nya ni// 'gugs byed gsod byed gsum dang mkha' 'gro bzhi// gdong can brgyad dang sgo mo bzhi la sogs// las byed pho nya rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol nor lha'i bkra shis shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// mnyam par gzhog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa yis// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*// 'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yis// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// snyan pa nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa dang*// rgyud ni nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba ste// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos shing*// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog

/gzhi phyag rgya chen po la 'gyur ba med// 'gyur med sku yi bkra shis shog /spyir 'gro drug yongs la bkra shis shog /sgos 'dir tshogs rnams la bkra shis shog /lam phyag rgya chen po la 'gags pa med// 'gags med gsung gi bkra shis shog /spyir 'gro drug yongs la bkra shis shog /sgos 'dir tshogs rnams la bkra shis shog/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po la 'khrul ba med// 'khrul med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /spyir 'gro drug yongs la bkra shis shog /sgos 'dir tshogs rnams la bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral 'khrul med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa| |chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog/ tshogs mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang*// bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin dpon slob bzhin du mthun pa yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ teṣāñtsa yo nī ro dha e waṃ wā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥswāhā/ o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/

zhes shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang rtse rang rab sde'i gnas brtan dbang 'dus dang dge phug rab sde'i gnas brtan tshangs spyod rnam gnyis nas da lta'i smon lam 'don srol de'i chog khrigs shig dgos pa'i bskul ma yang yang byung ba la brten nas/ thub dbang shākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi gzhung chog las nyung ngur btus pa zhes bya ba mtshan slob rta mgrin tshe dbang gis phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa de dang*/ drag dmar dang gsol bsdus rim pa rnams 'brug lugs 'don cha las khol du phyung ste/ shākya'i dge sbyong gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'jigs med chos kyi grags pas phyogs bsdebs bklag chog tu bkod pa dge'o/// /
